items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who fondles his wife in the month of Ramadan until he ejaculates.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him is, of the expiation, the like of what is upon the one who has intercourse.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ اَلْحَجَّاجِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ ع عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَعْبَثُ بِأَهْلِهِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ حَتَّى يُمْنِيَ قَالَ» عَلَيْهِ مِنَ اَلْكَفَّارَةِ مِثْلُ مَا عَلَى اَلَّذِي يُجَامِعُ«.

items.e: From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaah: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who was seized in the month of Ramadan, and he had broken his fast three times, and he had been brought before the (divinely appointed) Imam three times.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Let him be killed on the third.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أُخِذَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ قَدْ أَفْطَرَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ وَ قَدْ رُفِعَ إِلَى اَلْإِمَامِ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ قَالَ» فَلْيُقْتَلْ فِي اَلثَّالِثَةِ«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Jafar, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who deliberately broke his fast for a day from the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him are fifteen sa’, for every needy person one mudd according to the mudd of the Prophet (saws), and that is better.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَفْطَرَ يَوْماً مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مُتَعَمِّداً قَالَ »عَلَيْهِ خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ صَاعاً لِكُلِّ مِسْكِينٍ مُدٌّ بِمُدِّ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَفْضَلُ«.

items.e: And from him, from Abu Jafar, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from al-Mashriqi, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who deliberately broke his fast for some days from the month of Ramadan. What expiation is upon him?’ So the Imam (a.s), wrote: “Whoever deliberately breaks his fast for a day from month of Ramadan, upon him is freeing of a believing slave, and he fasts a day in place of a day.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْخَطَّابِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنِ اَلْمَشْرِقِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَفْطَرَ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَيَّاماً مُتَعَمِّداً مَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ اَلْكَفَّارَةِ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» مَنْ أَفْطَرَ يَوْماً مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مُتَعَمِّداً فَعَلَيْهِ عِتْقُ رَقَبَةٍ مُؤْمِنَةٍ وَ يَصُومُ يَوْماً بَدَلَ يَوْمٍ«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Ismail ibn Marrar and Abd al-Jabbar ibn Mubarak, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir and Samaah ibn Mihran, who both said: We (narrators) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man upon whom there is the fasting of two consecutive months, but he is not able to fast, and he is not able to free a slave, and he is not able to give charity.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Then let him fast eighteen days, for every ten needy persons, three days.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مَرَّارٍ وَ عَبْدِ اَلْجَبَّارِ بْنِ مُبَارَكٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ وَ سَمَاعَةَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ قَالاَ: سَأَلْنَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ صِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ فَلَمْ يَقْدِرْ عَلَى اَلصِّيَامِ وَ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ عَلَى اَلْعِتْقِ وَ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ عَلَى اَلصَّدَقَةِ قَالَ» فَلْيَصُمْ ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ يَوْماً عَنْ كُلِّ عَشَرَةِ مَسَاكِينَ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ«.

items.e: As for what Sa’ad narrated from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Amr ibn Said al-Madaini, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who, while fasting, has intercourse with his wife.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He performs ghusl, and there is nothing upon him.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ اَلْمَدَائِنِيِّ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ وَ هُوَ صَائِمٌ فَيُجَامِعُ أَهْلَهُ فَقَالَ »يَغْتَسِلُ وَ لاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Ali ibn al-Numan, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from Zurarah and Abu Basir, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who both said: We (narrators) asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who came to his wife in the month of Ramadan, and came to his wife while he was in the state of ihram, while he did not see except that this was lawful for him.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing upon him (due to their ignorance on the matter).”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالاَ جَمِيعاً: سَأَلْنَا أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَتَى أَهْلَهُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَأَتَى أَهْلَهُ وَ هُوَ مُحْرِمٌ وَ هُوَ لاَ يَرَى إِلاَّ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ حَلاَلٌ لَهُ قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ«.

items.e: As for what al-Husayn ibn Said narrated from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaah, who said: I asked him about ‘a man who deliberately came to his wife in the month of Ramadan’. So he said: “Upon him is the freeing of a slave, And feeding sixty needy persons, And fasting two consecutive months, And making up that day; and how could he have the like of that day?” – meaning that he would still not be able to attain the reward of that singular day of fasting in the month of Ramadan.
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَتَى أَهْلَهُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مُتَعَمِّداً فَقَالَ» عَلَيْهِ عِتْقُ رَقَبَةٍ وَ إِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِيناً وَ صِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ وَ قَضَاءُ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمِ وَ أَنَّى لَهُ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمِ«.

items.e: Abu Jafar Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Babawayh, from Abd al-Wahid ibn Muhammad ibn Abdus al-Naysaburi, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Qutaybah, from Hamdan ibn Sulayman, from Abd al-Salam ibn Salih al-Harawi, who said: I (narrator) said to Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him: “O son of the Messenger of Allah (swt), it has been narrated from your fathers (a.s), peace be upon them, regarding ‘one who has intercourse in the month of Ramadan or breaks his fast in it, that there are three expiations, and it has also been narrated from them, that there is one expiation. So by which of the two hadiths should we act?’” Imam (a.s) said: “By both of them together. Whenever a man has unlawful intercourse, or breaks his fast upon something unlawful, in the month of Ramadan, then upon him are three expiations: freeing a slave, fasting two consecutive months, and feeding sixty needy persons, and making up that day. But if he has married lawfully, or breaks his fast upon something lawful, then upon him is one expiation. And if he was forgetful, then there is nothing upon him.”
items.o: أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ بَابَوَيْهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلْوَاحِدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبْدُوسٍ اَلنَّيْسَابُورِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قُتَيْبَةَ عَنْ حَمْدَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلسَّلاَمِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ اَلْهَرَوِيِّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَا اِبْنَ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ قَدْ رُوِيَ عَنْ آبَائِكَ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ» فِيمَنْ جَامَعَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَوْ أَفْطَرَ فِيهِ ثَلاَثُ كَفَّارَاتٍ« وَ رُوِيَ عَنْهُمْ أَيْضاً» كَفَّارَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ« فَبِأَيِّ اَلْحَدِيثَيْنِ نَأْخُذُ قَالَ» بِهِمَا جَمِيعاً مَتَى جَامَعَ اَلرَّجُلُ حَرَاماً أَوْ أَفْطَرَ عَلَى حَرَامٍ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَعَلَيْهِ ثَلاَثُ كَفَّارَاتٍ عِتْقُ رَقَبَةٍ وَ صِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ وَ إِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِيناً وَ قَضَاءُ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ قَدْ نَكَحَ حَلاَلاً أَوْ أَفْطَرَ عَلَى حَلاَلٍ فَعَلَيْهِ كَفَّارَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ وَ إِنْ كَانَ نَاسِياً فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s): Imam (a.s) said: “It is disliked for the fasting person to immerse himself in water.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» يُكْرَهُ لِلصَّائِمِ أَنْ يَرْتَمِسَ فِي اَلْمَاءِ«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Imran ibn Musa, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Abdullah ibn Jabalah, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A fasting man deliberately immersed himself in water; is making up that day upon him?” Imam (a.s) said: “Making it up is not upon him, but he must certainly not return to doing it.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ جَبَلَةَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ صَائِمٌ اِرْتَمَسَ فِي اَلْمَاءِ مُتَعَمِّداً أَ عَلَيْهِ قَضَاءُ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمِ قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ قَضَاءٌ وَ لاَ يَعُودَنَّ«.

items.e: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Is ibn al-Qasim, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who became junub in the month of Ramadan at the beginning of the night, then delayed the ghusl until dawn rose.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He completes his fast, and there is no making up upon him.”
items.o: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عِيصِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَجْنَبَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فِي أَوَّلِ اَللَّيْلِ فَأَخَّرَ اَلْغُسْلَ حَتَّى طَلَعَ اَلْفَجْرُ قَالَ» يُتِمُّ صَوْمَهُ وَ لاَ قَضَاءَ عَلَيْهِ«.

items.e: And from him, from al-Nawfali, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Sulayman ibn Abi Zaynabah, who said: I (narrator) wrote to Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon them both, asking Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who became junub in the month of Ramadan from the beginning of the night, then delayed the ghusl until dawn rose.’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote to me in his own handwriting: “I know him with Musadif. He performs ghusl from his janabah, completes his fast, and there is nothing upon him.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلنَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي زَيْنَبَةَ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَجْنَبَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مِنْ أَوَّلِ اَللَّيْلِ فَأَخَّرَ اَلْغُسْلَ حَتَّى طَلَعَ اَلْفَجْرُ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِلَيَّ بِخَطِّهِ» أَعْرِفُهُ مَعَ مُصَادِفٍ يَغْتَسِلُ مِنْ جَنَابَتِهِ وَ يُتِمُّ صَوْمَهُ وَ لاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ«.

items.e: And from him, from Sa’ad ibn Ismail, from his father, from Ismail ibn Isa, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who was affected by janabah in the month of Ramadan, then slept until morning came; what is upon him?’ Imam (a.s) said: “This does not harm him, and he does not break his fast, for my father (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘Aisha said: Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, woke in the morning while junub from intercourse, not from a wet dream.’” Imam (a.s) said: “He does not break his fast, and he does not pay any attention to it.” (Narrator said) ‘And a man who was affected by janabah, then remained asleep until morning came; what is obligatory upon him?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing upon him; he performs ghusl.” (Narrator said) ‘And a man who was affected by janabah at the end of the night, so he rose to perform ghusl but did not find water, so he went to seek it, or sent someone to bring it to him, but it became difficult for him until morning came; how should he act?’ Imam (a.s) said: “He performs ghusl when it comes to him, then he prays.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عِيسَى قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَصَابَتْهُ جَنَابَةٌ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَنَامَ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ أَيُّ شَيْءٍ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ» لاَ يَضُرُّهُ هَذَا وَ لاَ يُفْطِرُ فَإِنَّ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ »قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَصْبَحَ جُنُباً مِنْ جِمَاعٍ غَيْرِ اِحْتِلاَمٍ«« قَالَ» لاَ يُفْطِرُ وَلاَ يُبَالِي« وَ رَجُلٌ أَصَابَتْهُ جَنَابَةٌ فَبَقِيَ نَائِماً حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ أَيُّ شَيْءٍ يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ» لاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ يَغْتَسِلُ« وَ رَجُلٌ أَصَابَتْهُ جَنَابَةٌ فِي آخِرِ اَللَّيْلِ فَقَامَ لِيَغْتَسِلَ وَ لَمْ يُصِبْ مَاءً فَذَهَبَ يَطْلُبُهُ أَوْ بَعَثَ مَنْ يَأْتِيهِ فَعَسُرَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى أَصْبَحَ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ» يَغْتَسِلُ إِذَا جَاءَهُ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaah ibn Mihran, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who was affected by janabah in the middle of the night in (month of) Ramadan, then slept while he knew of it, and did not wake up until dawn reached him.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him is that he completes his fast and makes up another day.” I (narrator) asked: “If that was from the man while he is making up (month of) Ramadan?” Imam (a.s) said: “Then let him eat on that day of his, and let him make it up, for nothing from the months resembles (month of) Ramadan.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَصَابَتْهُ جَنَابَةٌ فِي جَوْفِ اَللَّيْلِ فِي رَمَضَانَ فَنَامَ وَ قَدْ عَلِمَ بِهَا وَ لَمْ يَسْتَيْقِظْ حَتَّى يُدْرِكَهُ اَلْفَجْرُ فَقَالَ» عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُتِمَّ صَوْمَهُ وَ يَقْضِيَ يَوْماً آخَرَ« فَقُلْتُ إِذَا كَانَ ذَلِكَ مِنَ اَلرَّجُلِ وَ هُوَ يَقْضِي رَمَضَانَ قَالَ» فَلْيَأْكُلْ يَوْمَهُ ذَلِكَ وَلْيَقْضِ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يُشْبِهُ رَمَضَانَ شَيْءٌ مِنَ اَلشُّهُورِ«.

items.e: And from him, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abdullah ibn Abi Yafur, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “The man becomes junub in the month of Ramadan, then wakes up, then sleeps until morning comes.” Imam (a.s) said: “He completes his fast and makes up another day. But if he did not wake up until morning came, he completes his day, and it is valid for him.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلرَّجُلُ يُجْنِبُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ يَسْتَيْقِظُ ثُمَّ يَنَامُ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ قَالَ» يُتِمُّ صَوْمَهُ وَ يَقْضِي يَوْماً آخَرَ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَيْقِظْ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ أَتَمَّ يَوْمَهُ وَ جَازَ لَهُ«.

items.e: And from him, from Fadalah, from al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who is affected by janabah in (month of) Ramadan, then sleeps before performing ghusl.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He completes his fast and makes up that day, unless he wakes up before dawn rises. Then, if he waits for water to be heated or drawn, and dawn rises, then he does not make up his day.”
items.o: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ تُصِيبُهُ اَلْجَنَابَةُ فِي رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ يَنَامُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَغْتَسِلَ قَالَ» يُتِمُّ صَوْمَهُ وَ يَقْضِي ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَسْتَيْقِظَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَطْلُعَ اَلْفَجْرُ فَإِنِ اِنْتَظَرَ مَاءً يُسَخَّنُ أَوْ يُسْتَقَى فَطَلَعَ اَلْفَجْرُ فَلاَ يَقْضِي يَوْمَهُ«.

items.e: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who had intercourse with his wife in the month of Ramadan, or was affected by janabah, then slept until morning came deliberately.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He completes that day (of fast), and upon him is making it up.”
items.o: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَصَابَ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَوْ أَصَابَتْهُ جَنَابَةٌ ثُمَّ يَنَامُ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ مُتَعَمِّداً قَالَ» يُتِمُّ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمَ وَ عَلَيْهِ قَضَاؤُهُ«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Hammad ibn Isa and Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man becomes junub from the beginning of the night, then sleeps until morning comes in the month of Ramadan.” Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing upon him.” I (narrator) asked: “But if he wakes up, then sleeps until morning comes?” Imam (a.s) said: “Then let him make up that day as a punishment.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى وَ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلرَّجُلُ يُجْنِبُ مِنْ أَوَّلِ اَللَّيْلِ ثُمَّ يَنَامُ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ« قُلْتُ فَإِنَّهُ اِسْتَيْقَظَ ثُمَّ نَامَ حَتَّى أَصْبَحَ قَالَ» فَلْيَقْضِ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمَ عُقُوبَةً«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who became junub in the month of Ramadan at night, then deliberately left the ghusl until morning came.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He frees a slave, or fasts two consecutive months, or feeds sixty needy persons.” He (narrator) said: “And Imam (a.s) said: ‘Indeed, he is deserving that I do not see him ever attaining it (the merits of the original fast).’”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ أَجْنَبَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ بِاللَّيْلِ ثُمَّ تَرَكَ اَلْغُسْلَ مُتَعَمِّداً حَتَّى أَصْبَحَ قَالَ» يُعْتِقُ رَقَبَةً أَوْ يَصُومُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ أَوْ يُطْعِمُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِيناً« قَالَ وَ قَالَ» إِنَّهُ خَلِيقٌ أَنْ لاَ أَرَاهُ يُدْرِكُهُ أَبَداً«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Muhammad ibn Isa, who said: Sulayman ibn Hafs al-Marwazi narrated to me from al-Faqih (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “When a man becomes junub in the month of Ramadan at night and does not perform ghusl until morning comes, then upon him is the fasting of two consecutive months, along with the fasting of that day, and he does not attain the merit of his day.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ اَلْمَرْوَزِيُّ عَنِ اَلْفَقِيهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِذَا أَجْنَبَ اَلرَّجُلُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ بِلَيْلٍ وَ لاَ يَغْتَسِلُ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ فَعَلَيْهِ صَوْمُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مَعَ صَوْمِ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمِ وَ لاَ يُدْرِكُ فَضْلَ يَوْمِهِ«.

items.e: And from him, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Hammad, from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid, from some of his freed servants, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the wet dream of the fasting person.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he has a wet dream during the day in the month of Ramadan, then he must not sleep until he performs ghusl. And if he becomes junub at night in the month of Ramadan, then he has no right to sleep for an hour until he performs ghusl. So whoever becomes junub in the month of Ramadan, then sleeps until morning comes, then upon him is the freeing of a slave, or feeding sixty needy persons. And upon him is to making up that day, and he completes his fast, and he will never attain it (the merits of the original fast).”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ بَعْضِ مَوَالِيهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اِحْتِلاَمِ اَلصَّائِمِ قَالَ فَقَالَ» إِذَا اِحْتَلَمَ نَهَاراً فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَلاَ يَنَمْ حَتَّى يَغْتَسِلَ وَ إِنْ أَجْنَبَ لَيْلاً فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَلَيْسَ لَهُ أَنْ يَنَامَ سَاعَةً حَتَّى يَغْتَسِلَ فَمَنْ أَجْنَبَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَنَامَ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ فَعَلَيْهِ عِتْقُ رَقَبَةٍ أَوْ إِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِيناً وَ قَضَاءُ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمِ وَ يُتِمُّ صِيَامَهُ وَ لَنْ يُدْرِكَهُ أَبَداً«.

items.e: As for what Sa’ad ibn Abdullah narrated from Abu Jafar, from Sa’ad ibn Ismail ibn Isa, from his father, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who was affected by janabah in the month of Ramadan, then slept deliberately until morning came. What is upon him?’ Imam (a.s) said: “This does not harm him, and he does not break his fast, and he does not pay any attention to it, for my father (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘Aisha said: Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, woke in the morning while junub from intercourse, not from a wet dream.’”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَصَابَتْهُ جَنَابَةٌ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَنَامَ عَمْداً حَتَّى أَصْبَحَ أَيُّ شَيْءٍ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ» لاَ يَضُرُّهُ هَذَا وَ لاَ يُفْطِرُ وَ لاَ يُبَالِي فَإِنَّ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ» قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَصْبَحَ جُنُباً مِنْ جِمَاعٍ غَيْرِ اِحْتِلاَمٍ««.

items.e: Sa’ad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn and Muhammad ibn Ali, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Habib al-Khathami, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to perform the night prayer in the month of Ramadan, then become junub, then deliberately delay the ghusl until dawn rose.”
items.o: سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ حَبِيبٍ اَلْخَثْعَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ يُصَلِّي صَلاَةَ اَللَّيْلِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ يُجْنِبُ ثُمَّ يُؤَخِّرُ اَلْغُسْلَ مُتَعَمِّداً حَتَّى يَطْلُعَ اَلْفَجْرُ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Muhammad ibn Isa, who said: Sulayman ibn Hafs al-Marwazi narrated to me, saying: I (narrator) heard Imam (a.s) say: “If the fasting person rinses his mouth in the month of Ramadan, or sniffs water into his nose deliberately, or smells a thick odor, or sweeps a house and dust enters his nose or his throat, then upon him is the fasting of two consecutive months, for that is a breaking of the fast for him, like (the acts that break the fast) such as eating, drinking, and intercourse.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ اَلْمَرْوَزِيُّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ:» إِذَا تَمَضْمَضَ اَلصَّائِمُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَوِ اِسْتَنْشَقَ مُتَعَمِّداً أَوْ شَمَّ رَائِحَةً غَلِيظَةً أَوْ كَنَسَ بَيْتاً فَدَخَلَ فِي أَنْفِهِ أَوْ حَلْقِهِ غُبَارٌ فَعَلَيْهِ صَوْمُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فِطْرٌ مِثْلُ اَلْأَكْلِ وَ اَلشُّرْبِ وَاَلنِّكَاحِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Barraqah al-Asbahani, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad (a.s), from his father (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in kohl (applied to eyes) for the fasting person, and snuff (al-suut) was disliked for the fasting person.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ بَرَّاقَةَ اَلْأَصْبَهَانِيِّ عَنْ غِيَاثِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لاَ بَأْسَ بِالْكُحْلِ لِلصَّائِمِ وَ كُرِهَ اَلسُّعُوطُ لِلصَّائِمِ«.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Khazzaz, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from Imam Jafar al-Sadiq (a.s), from his father (a.s), from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Imam Ali (a.s) disliked snuff (al-suut) for the fasting person.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْخَزَّازِ عَنْ غِيَاثِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:» أَنَّهُ كَرِهَ اَلسُّعُوطَ لِلصَّائِمِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Burayd al-Ijli, who said: Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, was asked about ‘a man against whom witnesses testified that he broke his fast for three days from the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “This man is asked, ‘Is there any sin upon you for your breaking the fast in the month of Ramadan?’ If he says, ‘No,’ then upon the Imam is that he kill him. And if he says, ‘Yes,’ then upon the Imam is that he severely beat him.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ اَلْعِجْلِيِّ قَالَ: سُئِلَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِ شُهُودٌ أَنَّهُ أَ فْطَرَ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ قَالَ» يُسْأَلُ هَلْ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ إِفْطَارِكَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ إِثْمٌ فَإِنْ قَالَ لاَ فَإِنَّ عَلَى اَلْإِمَامِ أَنْ يَقْتُلَهُ وَ إِنْ قَا لَ نَعَمْ فَإِنَّ عَلَى اَلْإِمَامِ أَنْ يَنْهَكَهُ ضَرْباً«.
items.h: Chapter on Ruling of One Who Intentionally Breaks the Fast of a Day from the Month of Ramadan and What Punishment Is Obligatory upon Him for Breaking the Fast

items.e: And from him, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Bundar, from Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Ahmar, from Abdullah ibn Hammad, from al-Mufaddal ibn Umar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who came to his wife (for intimate relations) while he was fasting and she was fasting.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he compelled her, then upon him are two expiations. And if she obeyed him willingly, then upon him is an expiation and upon her is an expiation. And if he forced her, then upon him is the striking of fifty lashes, half the prescribed punishment. And if she obeyed him willingly, he is struck twenty-five lashes, and she is struck twenty-five lashes.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بُنْدَارَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ اَلْأَحْمَرِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْمُفَضَّلِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ أَتَى اِمْرَأَتَهُ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ وَهِيَ صَائِمَةٌ فَقَالَ» إِنْ كَانَ اِسْتَكْرَهَهَا فَعَلَيْهِ كَفَّارَتَانِ وَ إِنْ كَانَتْ طَاوَعَتْهُ فَعَلَيْهِ كَفَّارَةٌ وَ عَلَيْهَا كَفَّارَةٌ وَ إِنْ كَانَ أَكْرَهَهَا فَعَلَيْهِ ضَرْبُ خَمْسِينَ سَوْطاً نِصْفِ اَلْحَدِّ وَ إِنْ كَانَتْ طَاوَعَتْهُ ضُرِبَ خَمْسَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ سَوْطاً وَضُرِبَتْ خَمْسَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ سَوْطاً«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Asbat, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “When month of Ramadan enters, then Allah (swt) has a condition in it. Allah (swt), said: ‘So whoever among you witnesses the month, let him fast it.’ (Surah al-Baqarah 2:185) Therefore, when the month of Ramadan enters, a man has no right to go out except for Hajj, or Umrah, or wealth whose destruction he fears, or a brother whose destruction he fears. And he has no right to go out for the destruction of his brother’s wealth. Then when the night of the twenty-third (of the month of Ramadan) has passed, let him go out wherever he wishes.”
items.o: رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِذَا دَخَلَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ فَلِلَّهِ فِيهِ شَرْطٌ قَالَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى» فَمَنْ شَهِدَ مِنْكُمُ اَلشَّهْرَ فَلْيَصُمْهُ« فَلَيْسَ لِلرَّجُلِ إِذَا دَخَلَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ إِلاَّ فِي حَجٍّ أَوْ عُمْرَةٍ أَوْ مَالٍ يَخَافُ تَلَفَهُ أَوْ أَخٍ يَخَافُ هَلاَكَهُ وَ لَيْسَ لَهُ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ فِي إِتْلاَفِ مَالِ أَخِيهِ فَإِذَا مَضَتْ لَيْلَةُ ثَلاَثَةٍ وَ عِشْرِينَ فَلْيَخْرُجْ حَيْثُ شَاءَ«.
items.h: Chapter on Ruling of the Traveller and the Sick Person Regarding Fasting

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abd al-Aziz al-Abdi, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, regarding the saying of almighty Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic: ‘So whoever among you witnesses the month, let him fast it.’ (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:185) Imam (a.s) said: “How clear it is. Whoever witnesses it (the month of Ramadan), let him fast it, and whoever travels, let him not fast it.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلْعَزِيزِ اَلْعَبْدِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي قَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ» فَمَنْ شَهِدَ مِنْكُمُ اَلشَّهْرَ فَلْيَصُمْهُ« قَالَ »مَا أَبْيَنَهَا مَنْ شَهِدَ فَلْيَصُمْهُ وَ مَنْ سَافَرَ فَلاَ يَصُمْهُ«.

items.e: And from him, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Najran, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) heard Imam (a.s) saying: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘Indeed, Allah (swt) has given charity to the sick of my community and its travellers through shortening and breaking the fast. Would one of you be pleased, when he gives charity, that it be returned to him?’” – meaning to accept the concession Allah (swt) has provided via shortened prayers and breaking fasts for the sick and the travellers.
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ:» إِنَّ اَللَّهَ تَصَدَّقَ عَلَى مَرْضَى أُمَّتِي وَمُسَافِرِيهَا بِالتَّقْصِيرِ وَ اَلْإِفْطَارِ أَ يَسُرُّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا تَصَدَّقَ بِصَدَقَةٍ أَنْ تُرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ«.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Salamah ibn al-Khattab, from Sulayman ibn Samaah, from Ali ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn Hakim, who said: I (narrator) heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “If a man were to die while fasting during travel, I would not pray over him.” – meaning he rejected the concession of Allah (swt) provided to him and insisted to keep the fast.
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ اَلْخَطَّابِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً مَاتَ صَائِماً فِي اَلسَّفَرِ مَا صَلَّيْتُ عَلَيْهِ«.

items.e: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abd al-Malik ibn Utbah, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Yahya ibn Abi al-Ala, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “The fasting person in the month of Ramadan while travelling is like the one who breaks the fast while present at home.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “A man came to the Messenger of Allah (swt), and said, ‘O Messenger of Allah (swt), should I fast the month of Ramadan while travelling?’ So the Prophet (saws) said: “No.” The man replied said: “O Messenger of Allah (swt), it is easy for me.” So the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘Indeed, Allah (swt) has given charity (concession) to the sick of my community and its travellers by breaking the fast in the month of Ramadan. Would one of you like that, if he gave charity, it should be returned to him?’”
items.o: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» اَلصَّائِمُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ كَالْمُفْطِرِ فِي اَلْحَضَرِ« ثُمَّ قَالَ» إِنَّ رَجُلاً أَتَى رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ أَصُومُ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ فَقَالَ» لاَ« فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ إِنَّهُ عَلَيَّ يَسِيرٌ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ» إِنَّ اَللَّهَ تَصَدَّقَ عَلَى مَرْضَى أُمَّتِي وَمُسَافِرِيهَا بِالْإِفْطَارِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَيُعْجِبُ أَحَدَكُمْ أَنْ لَوْ تَصَدَّقَ بِصَدَقَةٍ أَنْ تُرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ««.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah: Abu Ja’far Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, named a people who continued to fast even when He (saws) broke the fast and shortened the prayer, He (saws) labelled them as ‘disobedient ones.’” Imam (a.s) said: “They remain known as the disobedient ones until the Day of Resurrection, and indeed we know their sons and the sons of their sons (descendants) up to this day of ours.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: »سَمَّى رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ قَوْماً صَامُوا حِينَ أَفْطَرَ وَ قَصَّرَ» عُصَاةً«« فَقَالَ» هُمُ اَلْعُصَاةُ إِلَى يَوْمِ اَلْقِيَامَةِ وَ إِنَّا لَنَعْرِفُ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ وَ أَبْنَاءَ أَبْنَائِهِمْ إِلَى يَوْمِنَا هَذَا«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: That Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a man who travels in the month of Ramadan and fasts.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Fasting during travel is not from righteousness.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُسَافِرُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَيَصُومُ فَقَالَ» لَيْسَ مِنَ اَلْبِرِّ اَلصِّيَامُ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from some of our companions, who raised it to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “Whoever prays four rakahs during his travel, then I am free of him before Allah (swt).” – meaning does not shorten his prayer.
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا رَفَعَهُ إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» مَنْ صَلَّى فِي سَفَرِهِ أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ فَأَنَا إِلَى اَللَّهِ مِنْهُ بَرِيءٌ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, all together from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “The hire-carrier (al-mukari) and the camel-driver (al-jammal), who goes back and forth and has no place of residence, thus he completes the prayer and fasts the month of Ramadan.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ جَمِيعاً عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» اَلْمُكَارِي وَ اَلْجَمَّالُ اَلَّذِي يَخْتَلِفُ وَ لَيْسَ لَهُ مُقَامٌ يُتِمُّ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ يَصُومُ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Ismail ibn Abi Ziyad, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), peace be upon him, from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam Ali (a.s) said: “Seven do not shorten the prayer: The commander who travels around within his command, The tax-collector (al-jabba) who travels around in his collection, The merchant who travels around in his trade from market to market, The Bedouin who seeks the places of rain and the growth of trees, The shepherd, The warrior who goes out to cut off the road, And the one who seeks hunting, intending by it the amusement of this world.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» سَبْعَةٌ لاَ يُقَصِّرُونَ اَلصَّلاَةَ اَلْأَمِيرُ اَلَّذِي يَدُورُ فِي إِمَارَتِهِ وَاَلْجَبَّاءُ اَلَّذِي يَدُورُ فِي جِبَايَتِهِ وَاَلتَّاجِرُ اَلَّذِي يَدُورُ فِي تِجَارَتِهِ مِنْ سُوقٍ إِلَى سُوقٍ وَاَلْبَدَوِيُّ اَلَّذِي يَطْلُبُ مَوَاضِعَ اَلْقَطْرِ وَمَنْبِتَ اَلشَّجَرِ وَاَلرَّاعِي وَاَلْمُحَارِبُ اَلَّذِي يَخْرُجُ لِقَطْعِ اَلسَّبِيلِ وَ اَلَّذِي يَطْلُبُ اَلصَّيْدَ يُرِيدُ بِهِ لَهْوَ اَلدُّنْيَا«.

items.e: And from Sindi ibn al-Rabi, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Concerning the carrier for hire (al-mukari) and the camel driver (al-jammal) who goes back and forth and has no place of stay (residence). Thus, he completes the prayer and fasts in the month of Ramadan.”
items.o: وعنه عن سندى بن الربيع قال: في المكاري والجمال الذي يختلف ليس له مقام يتم الصلاة ويصوم في شهر رمضان

items.e: As for what Sa’ad ibn Abdullah narrated from Abu Jafar, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Ibrahim (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the hire-carriers (al-mukarin) who hire out riding animals’, And I (narrator) asked: “They go back and forth every few days; whenever something comes to them, they go back and forth.” Imam (a.s) said: “Upon them is shortening whenever they travel.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُكَارِينَ اَلَّذِينَ يُكْرُونَ اَلدَّوَابَّ فَقُلْتُ يَخْتَلِفُونَ كُلَّ أَيَّامٍ كُلَّمَا جَاءَهُمْ شَيْءٌ اِخْتَلَفُوا فَقَالَ» عَلَيْهِمُ اَلتَّقْصِيرُ إِذَا مَا سَافَرُوا«.

items.e: From him, from Abu Jafar, from al-Husayn, from Fadalah, from Aban ibn Uthman, from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the hire-carriers (al-mukarin) who go back and forth.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If they hasten the journey seriously, then let them shorten.”
items.o: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمُكَارِينَ اَلَّذِينَ يَخْتَلِفُونَ فَقَالَ» إِذَا جَدُّوا اَلسَّيْرَ فَلْيُقَصِّرُوا«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Abu Ishaq Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from some of his men, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the limit of the hire-carrier (al-mukari) who fasts and completes the prayer.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Whichever hire-carrier (mukari) stays in his house, or in the town which he enters, for less than a stay of ten days, fasting and completion are always obligatory upon him. But if his stay in his house, or in the town which he enters, is more than ten days, then upon him are shortening and breaking the fast.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مَرَّارٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ بَعْضِ رِجَالِهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ حَدِّ اَلْمُكَارِي اَلَّذِي يَصُومُ وَ يُتِمُّ قَالَ» أَيُّمَا مُكَارٍ أَقَامَ فِي مَنْزِلِهِ أَوْ فِي اَلْبَلَدِ اَلَّذِي يَدْخُلُهُ أَقَلَّ مِنْ مُقَامِ عَشَرَةِ أَيَّامٍ وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلصِّيَامُ وَ اَلتَّمَامُ أَبَداً وَ إِنْ كَانَ مُقَامُهُ فِي مَنْزِلِهِ أَوْ فِي اَلْبَلَدِ اَلَّذِي يَدْخُلُهُ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ عَشَرَةِ أَيَّامٍ فَعَلَيْهِ اَلتَّقْصِيرُ وَ اَلْإِفْطَارُ«.

items.e: Indicating that is what Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Abu Ayyub, from Ammar ibn Marwan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) heard Imam (a.s) saying: “Whoever travels shortens and breaks the fast, unless he is a man whose travel is for hunting (for amusement), or in disobedience to Allah (swt), the Exalted, or a messenger for one who disobeys Allah (swt), or in pursuit of enmity, or an effort to cause harm against a group of the Muslims.”
items.o: يَدُلُّ عَلَى ذَلِكَ مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ:» مَنْ سَافَرَ قَصَّرَ وَ أَفْطَرَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ رَجُلاً سَفَرُهُ فِي اَلصَّيْدِ أَوْ فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اَللَّهِ تَعَالَى أَوْ رَسُولاً لِمَنْ يَعْصِي اَللَّهَ أَوْ فِي طَلَبِ شَحْنَاءَ أَوْ سِعَايَةِ ضَرَرٍ عَلَى قَوْمٍ مِنَ اَلْمُسْلِمِينَ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from al-Abbas ibn Amir and Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Hakim, all together from Aban ibn Uthman al-Ahmar, from Zurarah, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘one who goes out from his family (home) with falcons (al-suqurah) and dogs, amusing himself for two or three nights. Does he shorten his prayer or not?’ Imam (a.s) said: “He does not shorten. He only went out for amusement.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ وَ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ جَمِيعاً عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ اَلْأَحْمَرِ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَمَّنْ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ بِالصُّقُورَةِ وَاَلْكِلاَبِ يَتَنَزَّهُ اَللَّيْلَتَيْنِ وَ اَلثَّلاَثَ هَلْ يُقَصِّرُ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ أَوْ لاَ فَقَالَ» لاَ يُقَصِّرُ إِنَّمَا خَرَجَ فِي لَهْوٍ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ahmad ibn Hilal, from Abu Saeed al-Khurasani, who said: Two men entered upon Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, in Khurasan, and they asked Imam (a.s) about ‘shortening the prayer.’ Imam (a.s) said to one of them: “Shortening (the prayer) has become obligatory upon you because you intended to come to me (the rightful Imam (a.s)),” And Imam (a.s) said to the other: “Completing the prayer has become obligatory upon you because you intended to go to the ruler (other than the Imam (a.s)).”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ اَلْخُرَاسَانِيِّ قَالَ: دَخَلَ رَجُلاَنِ عَلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ بِخُرَاسَانَ فَسَأَلاَهُ عَنِ اَلتَّقْصِيرِ فَقَالَ لِأَحَدِهِمَا» وَجَبَ عَلَيْكَ اَلتَّقْصِيرُ لِأَنَّكَ قَصَدْتَنِي« وَ قَالَ لِلْآخَرِ» وَجَبَ عَلَيْكَ اَلتَّمَامُ لِأَنَّكَ قَصَدْتَ اَلسُّلْطَانَ«.

items.e: What indicates that is what Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “A man fasted while travelling.” Imam (a.s) said: “If it had reached him that the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah’s (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, forbade that, then he must make it up. And if it had not reached him, then there is nothing upon him.”
items.o: يَدُلُّ عَلَى ذَلِكَ مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ رَجُلٌ صَامَ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ قَالَ» إِنْ كَانَ بَلَغَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ نَهَى عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَعَلَيْهِ اَلْقَضَاءُ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ بَلَغَهُ فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Ibn Abi Shu’bah, said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man fasted while travelling.” Imam (a.s) said: “If it had reached him that the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, forbade that, then upon him is making it up; And if it had not reached him, then there is nothing upon him.”
items.o: الحسين بن سعيد عن ابن ابي عمير عن حماد عن ابن ابي شعبة قال: قلت لابي عبد الله عليه السلام رجل صام في السفر فقال: إن كان بلغه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله نهى عن ذلك فعليه القضاء، وان لم يكن بلغه فلا شئ عليه

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Safwan, from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, who said: I (narrator) heard Imam (a.s) saying, “If a man fasts (month of) Ramadan while travelling, it does not suffice him, and he must repeat it.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ نُوحٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ:» إِذَا صَامَ اَلرَّجُلُ رَمَضَانَ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ لَمْ يُجْزِهِ وَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْإِعَادَةُ«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who fasted the month of Ramadan while travelling.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If it had not reached him that the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah’s (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, forbade that, then he does not have to make it up, and the fast has sufficed for him.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْجَبَّارِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ صَامَ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ فَقَالَ» إِنْ كَانَ لَمْ يَبْلُغْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ نَهَى عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْقَضَاءُ وَ قَدْ أَجْزَأَ عَنْهُ اَلصَّوْمُ«.

items.e: What indicates that is what al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal narrated from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Is ibn al-Qasim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “Regarding shortening (the prayer), its limit is twenty-four miles.”
items.o: يَدُلُّ عَلَى ذَلِكَ مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عِيصِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» فِي اَلتَّقْصِيرِ حَدُّهُ أَرْبَعَةٌ وَ عِشْرُونَ مِيلاً«.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad and Ahmad, the two sons of al-Hasan, his two brothers, from their father, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who leaves his house intending another house of his, or another estate of his.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If between him and his house, or his estate which he is heading toward, there are two barids, he shortens, and if it is less than that, he completes.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَحْمَدَ اِبْنَيِ اَلْحَسَنِ أَخَوَيْهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ مَنْزِلِهِ يُرِيدُ مَنْزِلاً لَهُ آخَرَ أَوْ ضَيْعَةً لَهُ أُخْرَى قَالَ» إِنْ كَانَ بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ مَنْزِلِهِ أَوْ ضَيْعَتِهِ اَلَّتِي يَؤُمُّ بَرِيدَانِ قَصَّرَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ دُونَ ذَلِكَ أَتَمَّ«.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah, and from Harun ibn Muslim, all from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘shortening the prayer.’ I (narrator) said: “I have an estate near al-Kufah, and it is in the position of al-Qadisiyyah in relation to al-Kufah. Sometimes a need arises for me by which I benefit from it, or staying away from it harms me, during (month of) Ramadan. So I dislike going out to it as I do not know whether I should fast or break the fast.” Imam (a.s) said: “So go out, complete prayer, and fast, for I have seen al-Qadisiyyah.” So I (narrator) asked: “In what is the least distance in which the prayer is shortened?” Imam (a.s) said: “The Sunnah has proceeded with the whiteness of a day.” So I (narrator) said to him: “The whiteness of a day differs, for a man may travel fifteen farsakhs in a day, and another may travel four farsakhs and five farsakhs in a day.” Imam (a.s) said: “It is not to that which consideration is given. Have you not seen the course of these miles between Makkah and al-Madinah?” Then Imam (a.s) gestured with his hand, “Twenty-four miles, which is eight farsakhs.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ وَ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ جَمِيعاً عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ اَلْحَجَّاجِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ ع قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلتَّقْصِيرِ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّ لِي ضَيْعَةً قَرِيبَةً مِنَ اَلْكُوفَةِ وَ هِيَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ اَلْقَادِسِيَّةِ مِنَ اَلْكُوفَةِ فَرُبَّمَا عَرَضَتْ لِيَ اَلْحَاجَةُ أَنْتَفِعُ بِهَا أَوْ يَضُرُّنِي اَلْقُعُودُ عَنْهَا فِي رَمَضَانَ فَأَكْرَهُ اَلْخُرُوجَ إِلَيْهَا لِأَنِّي لاَ أَدْرِي أَصُومُ أَوْ أُفْطِرُ فَقَالَ لِي» فَاخْرُجْ وَ أَتِمَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ صُمْ فَإِنِّي قَدْ رَأَيْتُ اَلْقَادِسِيَّةَ« فَقُلْتُ لَهُ فِي كَمْ أَدْنَى مَا تُقْصَرُ فِيهِ اَلصَّلاَةُ قَالَ» جَرَتِ اَلسُّنَّةُ بِبَيَاضِ يَوْمٍ« فَقُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّ بَيَاضَ يَوْمٍ يَخْتَلِفُ فَيَسِيرُ اَلرَّجُلُ خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ فَرْسَخاً فِي يَوْمٍ وَ يَسِيرُ اَلْآخَرُ أَرْبَعَةَ فَرَاسِخَ وَ خَمْسَةَ فَرَاسِخَ فِي يَوْمٍ فَقَالَ» إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ إِلَى ذَلِكَ يُنْظَرُ أَمَا رَأَيْتَ سَيْرَ هَذِهِ اَلْأَمْيَالِ بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَاَلْمَدِينَةِ« ثُمَّ أَوْمَى بِيَدِهِ أَرْبَعَةً وَعِشْرِينَ مِيلاً تَكُونُ ثَمَانِيَةَ فَرَاسِخَ.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Hasan, from Zurah, from Samaah, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the traveller, at what distance does he shorten the prayer?’ Imam (a.s) said: “At the journey of a day, and it is eight farsakhs (24 miles). Whoever travels and shortens the prayer breaks the fast, unless he is a man accompanying someone, or he goes out for hunting, or to a village of his, and it is the journey of a day, but he does not stay overnight away from his family; he does not shorten and he does not break the fast.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُسَافِرِ فِي كَمْ يَقْصُرُ اَلصَّلاَةَ فَقَالَ» فِي مَسِيرَةِ يَوْمٍ وَ هِيَ ثَمَانِيَةُ فَرَاسِخَ وَ مَنْ سَافَرَ فَقَصَرَ اَلصَّلاَةَ أَفْطَرَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ رَجُلاً مُشَيِّعاً أَوْ يَخْرُجَ إِلَى صَيْدٍ أَوْ إِلَى قَرْيَةٍ لَهُ فَتَكُونَ مَسِيرَةَ يَوْمٍ لاَ يَبِيتُ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ لاَ يَقْصُرُ وَ لاَ يُفْطِرُ«.

items.e: And from him, from al-Nadr, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Abu Basir, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “At what distance does a man shorten (the prayers)?” Imam (a.s) said: “At the whiteness of a day, or two barids.” – meaning two postal stages (baridan) equal approximately 24 miles. Imam (a.s) said: “For the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah’s (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, went out to Dhu Khushub and shortened (the prayers).” So I (narrator) asked: “How far is Dhu Khushub?” Imam (a.s) said: “Two barids.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي كَمْ يَقْصُرُ اَلرَّجُلُ فَقَالَ» فِي بَيَاضِ يَوْمٍ أَوْ بَرِيدَيْنِ« قَالَ» فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ خَرَجَ إِلَى ذِي خُشُبٍ فَقَصَرَ« فَقُلْتُ فَكَمْ ذِي خُشُبٍ فَقَالَ» بَرِيدَانِ«.

items.e: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn Hakam, from Abdullah ibn Yahya al-Kahili, who said: I (narrator) heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), saying regarding shortening the prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “A barid by a barid is twenty-four miles.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, my father (a.s) used to say, ‘Shortening was not set according to the swift mule (al-baghlah al-safwa) or the fast mount (al-dabbah al-najiyah), but rather it was set according to the travelling pace of the caravan (al-qitar).’”
items.o: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حَكَمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ يَحْيَى اَلْكَاهِلِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: فِي اَلتَّقْصِيرِ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ» بَرِيدٌ فِي بَرِيدٍ أَرْبَعَةٌ وَ عِشْرُونَ مِيلاً« ثُمَّ قَالَ» إِنَّ أَبِي كَانَ يَقُولُ» إِنَّ اَلتَّقْصِيرَ لَمْ يُوضَعْ عَلَى اَلْبَغْلَةِ اَلسَّفْوَاءِ أَوِ اَلدَّابَّةِ اَلنَّاجِيَةِ وَ إِنَّمَا وُضِعَ عَلَى سَيْرِ اَلْقِطَارِ««.

items.e: As for what Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “Shortening (the prayer) is in one barid, and one barid is four farsakhs.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» اَلتَّقْصِيرُ فِي بَرِيدٍ وَاَلْبَرِيدُ أَرْبَعَةُ فَرَاسِخَ«.

items.e: And from him, from Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu Ayyub, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, “What is the least distance in which the traveller shortens (the prayer)?” Imam (a.s) said: “One barid.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَدْنَى مَا يَقْصُرُ فِيهِ اَلْمُسَافِرُ فَقَالَ» بَرِيدٌ«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadalah, from Hammad, from Zayd al-Shahham, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, saying, “A man shortens (the prayer) at the journey of twelve miles (four farsakhs).”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ زَيْدٍ اَلشَّحَّامِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» يَقْصُرُ اَلرَّجُلُ فِي مَسِيرَةِ اِثْنَيْ عَشَرَ مِيلاً«.

items.e: And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “Shortening (the prayer) is in one barid, and one barid is four farsakhs.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» اَلتَّقْصِيرُ فِي بَرِيدٍ وَ اَلْبَرِيدُ أَرْبَعَةُ فَرَاسِخَ«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadalah, from Muawiyah ibn Wahb, who said: I (narrator) said: “What is the least distance in which the traveller shortens the prayer?” He said: “One barid going and one barid coming.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ أَدْنَى مَا يَقْصُرُ فِيهِ اَلْمُسَافِرُ اَلصَّلاَةَ قَالَ» بَرِيدٌ ذَاهِباً وَ بَرِيدٌ جَائِياً«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from his father, from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ribat, from al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘shortening (the prayer).’ Imam (a.s) said: “In one barid.” He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘One barid?’” Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, when he goes one barid and returns one barid, it occupies his day.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ رِبَاطٍ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلتَّقْصِيرِ قَالَ» فِي بَرِيدٍ« قَالَ قُلْتُ بَرِيدٌ قَالَ» إِنَّهُ إِذَا ذَهَبَ بَرِيداً وَ رَجَعَ بَرِيداً شَغَلَ يَوْمَهُ«.

items.e: As for what Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Abdullah ibn Abi Khalaf, from Yahya ibn Hashim, from Abu Harun al-Abdi, from Abu Saeed al-Khudri: (Abu Saeed al-Khudri) said: “When the Prophet (saws), Allah’s (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, travelled one farsakh, He (saws) would shorten the prayer.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي هَارُونَ اَلْعَبْدِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ اَلْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ: كَانَ اَلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ إِذَا سَافَرَ فَرْسَخاً قَصَّرَ اَلصَّلاَةَ.

items.e: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Amr ibn Said, who said: Jafar ibn Ahmad wrote to him, asking him about ‘travel and at what distance shortening (of prayers) is required.’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote in his own handwriting, and I recognized it. He said: “The Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, when he travelled and went out on a journey, would shorten at one farsakh.” Then in the following year, he repeated the question to him, so the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote to him: “In ten days.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ كَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ جَعْفَرُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ: يَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ اَلسَّفَرِ وَ فِي كَمِ اَلتَّقْصِيرُ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ بِخَطِّهِ وَ أَنَا أَعْرِفُهُ قَالَ» كَانَ أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِذَا سَافَرَ وَ خَرَجَ فِي سَفَرٍ قَصَّرَ فِي فَرْسَخٍ« ثُمَّ أَعَادَ مِنْ قَابِلٍ اَلْمَسْأَلَةَ إِلَيْهِ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِلَيْهِ» فِي عَشَرَةِ أَيَّامٍ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Amr ibn Said, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn Musa, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who goes out for a need and travels five farsakhs or six farsakhs, then comes to a village and stops in it. Then, he leaves from it and travels another five farsakhs and six; that is not permissible, then he stops in that place.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He is not a traveller until he travels from his house or his village eight farsakhs, so let him complete the prayer.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ فِي حَاجَةٍ فَيَسِيرُ خَمْسَةَ فَرَاسِخَ أَوْ سِتَّةَ فَرَاسِخَ فَيَأْتِي قَرْيَةً فَيَنْزِلُ فِيهَا ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا فَيَسِيرُ خَمْسَةَ فَرَاسِخَ أُخْرَى وَ سِتَّةً لاَ يَجُوزُ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ يَنْزِلُ فِي ذَلِكَ اَلْمَوْضِعِ قَالَ» لاَ يَكُونُ مُسَافِراً حَتَّى يَسِيرَ مِنْ مَنْزِلِهِ أَوْ قَرْيَتِهِ ثَمَانِيَةَ فَرَاسِخَ فَلْيُتِمَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from a man, from Safwan, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who left Baghdad intending to catch up with a man at the head of a mile, and he continued following him until he reached al-Nahrawan, and it is four farsakhs from Baghdad. Should he break the fast when he intends to return, and should he shorten (the prayer)?’ Imam (a.s) said: “He does not shorten (the prayer) and he does not break the fast, because he left his house while not intending to travel eight farsakhs. Rather, he left intending to catch up with his companion on part of the road, then the journey extended with him to the place that he reached. And if he had left his house intending al-Nahrawan, going and coming, then it would have been upon him to intend travel from the night, and to break the fast. But if he entered the morning and had not intended travel, then after he entered the morning travel occurred to him, he shortens and does not break his fast on that day.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ خَرَجَ مِنْ بَغْدَادَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَلْحَقَ رَجُلاً عَلَى رَأْسِ مِيلٍ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَتْبَعُهُ حَتَّى بَلَغَ اَلنَّهْرَوَانَ وَ هِيَ أَرْبَعَةُ فَرَاسِخَ مِنْ بَغْدَادَ أَ يُفْطِرُ إِذَا أَرَادَ اَلرُّجُوعَ وَ يُقَصِّرُ فَقَالَ» لاَ يُقَصِّرُ وَ لاَ يُفْطِرُ لِأَنَّهُ خَرَجَ مِنْ مَنْزِلِهِ وَ لَيْسَ يُرِيدُ اَلسَّفَرَ ثَمَانِيَةَ فَرَاسِخَ وَ إِنَّمَا خَرَجَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَلْحَقَ صَاحِبَهُ فِي بَعْضِ اَلطَّرِيقِ فَتَمَادَى بِهِ اَلسَّيْرُ إِلَى اَلْمَوْضِعِ اَلَّذِي بَلَغَهُ وَ لَوْ أَنَّهُ خَرَجَ مِنْ مَنْزِلِهِ يُرِيدُ اَلنَّهْرَوَانَ ذَاهِباً وَ جَائِياً لَكَانَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَنْوِيَ مِنَ اَللَّيْلِ سَفَراً وَ اَلْإِفْطَارَ فَإِنْ هُوَ أَصْبَحَ وَ لَمْ يَنْوِ اَلسَّفَرَ فَبَدَا لَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ أَنْ أَصْبَحَ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ قَصَّرَ وَ لَمْ يُفْطِرْ يَوْمَهُ ذَلِكَ«.

items.e: And that which Sa’ad ibn Abdullah narrated from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Amr ibn Said al-Madaini, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-Sabati, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who goes out for a need of his while he does not intend travel, then he proceeds in that and the proceeding extends with him until he proceeds eight farsakhs. What should he do regarding his prayer?’ Imam (a.s) said: “He shortens (the prayer) and does not complete the prayer until he returns to his house.”
items.o: وَ اَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ اَلْمَدَائِنِيِّ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ فِي حَاجَةٍ لَهُ وَ هُوَ لاَ يُرِيدُ اَلسَّفَرَ فَيَمْضِي فِي ذَلِكَ وَيَتَمَادَى بِهِ اَلْمُضِيُّ حَتَّى يَمْضِيَ بِهِ ثَمَانِيَةَ فَرَاسِخَ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ فِي صَلاَتِهِ قَالَ» يُقَصِّرُ وَ لاَ يُتِمُّ اَلصَّلاَةَ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ إِلَى مَنْزِلِهِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Sulayman ibn Hafs al-Marwazi, who said: The jurist, Imam al-Hadi (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Shortening the prayer is required at the distance of two barids, which is twenty-four miles, or at the distance of one barid when going and returning. One barid is six miles, and that is two farsakhs. Therefore, shortening the prayer applies at four farsakhs. So when a man leaves his house intending to travel twelve miles, which is four farsakhs, and he reaches two farsakhs while still intending to return another two farsakhs, he shortens his prayer. But if he turns back from his original intention when he reaches two farsakhs, and wishes to remain there, then he must perform the prayer in full. And if he had already shortened his prayer, then turned back from his intention, he must repeat the prayer.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ حَفْصٍ اَلْمَرْوَزِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ اَلْفَقِيهُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: »اَلتَّقْصِيرُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ بَرِيدَانِ أَوْ بَرِيدٌ ذَاهِباً وَ جَائِياً وَاَلْبَرِيدُ سِتَّةُ أَمْيَالٍ وَ هُوَ فَرْسَخَانِ فَالتَّقْصِيرُ فِي أَرْبَعَةِ فَرَاسِخَ فَإِذَا خَرَجَ اَلرَّجُلُ مِنْ مَنْزِلِهِ يُرِيدُ اِثْنَيْ عَشَرَ مِيلاً وَ ذَلِكَ أَرْبَعَةُ فَرَاسِخَ ثُمَّ بَلَغَ فَرْسَخَيْنِ وَ نِيَّتُهُ اَلرُّجُوعُ أَوْ فَرْسَخَيْنِ آخَرَيْنِ قَصَّرَ وَ إِنْ رَجَعَ عَمَّا نَوَى عِنْدَمَا بَلَغَ فَرْسَخَيْنِ وَ أَرَادَ اَلْمُقَامَ فَعَلَيْهِ اَلتَّمَامُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ قَصَّرَ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ عَنْ نِيَّتِهِ أَعَادَ اَلصَّلاَةَ«.

items.e: As for what Sa’ad ibn Abdullah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from al-Hasan ibn Musa, from Zurarah, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who goes out on a journey that he intends, then the time enters upon him while he has gone out from the village by two farsakhs, so they prayed and departed, then some of them turned back for a need, and going out was not decreed for him. What should he do regarding the prayer that he had prayed as two rakahs?’ Imam (a.s) said: “His prayer is complete, and he does not repeat it.”
items.o: وَ أَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ فِي سَفَرٍ يُرِيدُهُ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْوَقْتُ وَ قَدْ خَرَجَ مِنَ اَلْقَرْيَةِ عَلَى فَرْسَخَيْنِ فَصَلَّوْا وَاِنْصَرَفُوا فَانْصَرَفَ بَعْضُهُمْ فِي حَاجَةٍ فَلَمْ يُقْضَ لَهُ اَلْخُرُوجُ مَا يَصْنَعُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ اَلَّتِي كَانَ صَلاَّهَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَالَ» تَمَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ لاَ يُعِيدُ«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said narrated from Hammad, from Yaqub ibn Shuayb, from Abu Basir, who said: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “When a man resolves to stay for ten (days), then he must complete the prayer. But if he is in doubt, not knowing how long he will stay, and he says, ‘Today or tomorrow,’ then let him shorten between that and a month. Then if he stays in that town for more than a month, let him complete the prayer.”
items.o: وَ رَوَى اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: »إِذَا عَزَمَ اَلرَّجُلُ أَنْ يُقِيمَ عَشْراً فَعَلَيْهِ إِتْمَامُ اَلصَّلاَةِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ فِي شَكٍّ لاَ يَدْرِي مَا يُقِيمُ فَيَقُولُ اَلْيَوْمَ أَوْ غَداً فَلْيُقَصِّرْ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ شَهْرٍ فَإِنْ أَقَامَ بِذَلِكَ اَلْبَلَدِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ شَهْرٍ فَلْيُتِمَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ«

items.e: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Ashyam, from Sulayman ibn Jafar al-Jafari, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who intends to travel in the month of Ramadan, then leaves his family (home) after he has entered the morning.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he entered the morning among his family, then fasting that day has become obligatory upon him, unless he travels by night, a night journey (daljah).”
items.o: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَشْيَمَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ اَلْجَعْفَرِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَنْوِي اَلسَّفَرَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَيَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ بَعْدَ مَا يُصْبِحُ قَالَ» إِذَا أَصْبَحَ فِي أَهْلِهِ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ صِيَامُ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُدْلِجَ دَلْجَةً«.

items.e: And from him, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Rifaah, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man to whom travel presents itself in the month of Ramadan until he enters the morning.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He completes his fast on that day.” He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘Then he comes forward in the month of Ramadan, and there is not between him and his family except the morning part of the day.’” Imam (a.s) said: “When dawn rises while he is outside, then he has the choice: if he wishes, he fasts, and if he wishes, he breaks the fast.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَعْرِضُ لَهُ اَلسَّفَرُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ قَالَ» يُتِمُّ صَوْمَهُ يَوْمَهُ ذَلِكَ« قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنَّهُ أَقْبَلَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَلَمْ يَكُنْ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ أَهْلِهِ إِلاَّ ضَحْوَةٌ مِنَ اَلنَّهَارِ قَالَ فَقَالَ» إِذَا طَلَعَ اَلْفَجْرُ وَ هُوَ خَارِجٌ فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ إِنْ شَاءَ صَامَ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ أَفْطَرَ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Ali ibn Yaqtin, from Abu al-Hasan Musa (a.s), peace be upon him: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who travels in the month of Ramadan: should he break the fast in his house?’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he had spoken to himself at night about travelling, he breaks the fast when he leaves his house. But if he had not spoken to himself from the night, then travel occurred to him during his day, he completes his fast.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ نُوحٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُسَافِرُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَ يُفْطِرُ فِي مَنْزِلِهِ قَالَ» إِذَا حَدَّثَ نَفْسَهُ بِاللَّيْلِ بِالسَّفَرِ أَفْطَرَ إِذَا خَرَجَ مِنْ مَنْزِلِهِ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يُحَدِّثْ نَفْسَهُ مِنَ اَللَّيْلَةِ ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ مِنْ يَوْمِهِ أَتَمَّ صَوْمَهُ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Abdullah ibn Amir, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from the one who narrated it, from Abu Basir: (Abu Basir) said: “If you leave after the rising of dawn and did not intend travel from the night, then complete the fast and count it as part of the month of Ramadan.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَمَّنْ رَوَاهُ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ:» إِذَا خَرَجْتَ بَعْدَ طُلُوعِ اَلْفَجْرِ وَ لَمْ تَنْوِ اَلسَّفَرَ مِنَ اَللَّيْلِ فَأَتِمَّ اَلصَّوْمَ وَاِعْتَدَّ بِهِ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ«.

items.e: And that which Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a man who leaves his house while intending travel and while he is fasting.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he leaves before the day reaches its midpoint, then let him break the fast and make up that day. But if he leaves after midday, then let him complete his day.”
items.o: وَ اَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْتِهِ وَ هُوَ يُرِيدُ اَلسَّفَرَ وَ هُوَ صَائِمٌ قَالَ» إِنْ خَرَجَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَنْتَصِفَ اَلنَّهَارُ فَلْيُفْطِرْ وَ لْيَقْضِ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمَ وَ إِنْ خَرَجَ بَعْدَ اَلزَّوَالِ فَلْيُتِمَّ يَوْمَهُ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “When a man travels in the month of Ramadan and leaves after half of the day, then he must fast that day and count it as part of the month of Ramadan. Then, when he enters a town before the rising of dawn while intending to stay in it, then he must fast that day. But if he enters after the rising of dawn, then there is no fast upon him, though if he wishes, he may fast.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِذَا سَافَرَ اَلرَّجُلُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَخَرَجَ بَعْدَ نِصْفِ اَلنَّهَارِ فَعَلَيْهِ صِيَامُ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمِ وَ يَعْتَدُّ بِهِ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَإِذَا دَخَلَ إِلَى بَلَدٍ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ اَلْفَجْرِ وَ هُوَ يُرِيدُ اَلْإِقَامَةَ بِهَا فَعَلَيْهِ صَوْمُ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمِ فَإِنْ دَخَلَ بَعْدَ طُلُوعِ اَلْفَجْرِ فَلاَ صِيَامَ عَلَيْهِ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ صَامَ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Abdullah ibn Amir, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Safwan, from Samaah and Ibn Muskan, from a man, from Abu Basir, who said: I (narrator) heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “When you intend to travel in the month of Ramadan and you intend to leave from the night, then if you leave before dawn or after it, you are one who breaks the fast, and you must make up that day.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ وَ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» إِذَا أَرَدْتَ اَلسَّفَرَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَنَوَيْتَ اَلْخُرُوجَ مِنَ اَللَّيْلِ فَإِنْ خَرَجْتَ قَبْلَ اَلْفَجْرِ أَوْ بَعْدَهُ فَأَنْتَ مُفْطِرٌ وَ عَلَيْكَ قَضَاءُ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمِ«.

items.e: As for what Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated from Imran ibn Musa, from Musa ibn Jafar, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Abd al-Ala, the client of the family of Sa’m: (He was asked) regarding ‘a man who intends to travel in the month of Ramadan.’ He said: “He breaks the fast, even if he leaves shortly before the sun disappears.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلْأَعْلَى مَوْلَى آلِ سَامٍ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُرِيدُ اَلسَّفَرَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ قَالَ» يُفْطِرُ وَ إِنْ خَرَجَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغِيبَ اَلشَّمْسُ بِقَلِيلٍ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Abdullah ibn Amir, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘shortening (the prayer).’ Imam (a.s) said: “When you are in the place in which you hear the call to prayer, then complete, and when you are in the place in which you do not hear the call to prayer, then shorten. And when you arrive from a journey, then it is like that.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَ انَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلتَّقْصِيرِ قَالَ» إِذَا كُنْتَ فِي اَلْمَوْضِعِ اَلَّذِي تَسْمَعُ فِيهِ اَلْأَذَانَ فَأَتِمَّ وَ إِذَا كُنْتَ فِي اَلْمَوْضِعِ اَلَّذِي لاَ تَسْمَعُ فِيهِ اَلْأَذَانَ فَقَصِّرْ وَ إِذَا قَدِمْتَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ فَمِثْلُ ذَلِكَ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man intends to travel; when does he shorten (the prayer)?” Imam (a.s) said: “When he disappears from the houses.” He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘A man intends to travel, then he leaves when the sun declines.’” Imam (a.s) said: “When you leave, pray two rakahs.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلرَّجُلُ يُرِيدُ اَلسَّفَرَ مَتَى يُقَصِّرُ قَالَ» إِذَا تَوَارَى مِنَ اَلْبُيُوتِ «قَالَ قُلْتُ اَلرَّجُلُ يُرِيدُ اَلسَّفَرَ فَيَخْرُجُ حِينَ تَزُولُ اَلشَّمْسُ قَالَ» إِذَا خَرَجْتَ فَصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ«

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaah, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘fasting while travelling.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no fasting while travelling. Some people fasted during the time of the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah’s (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, so the Prophet (saws) named them the ‘disobedient ones’. Thus there is no fasting while travelling except the three days which Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, mentioned regarding the Hajj.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصِّيَامِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ فَقَالَ» لاَ صِيَامَ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ قَدْ صَامَ أُنَاسٌ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فَسَمَّاهُمُ اَلْعُصَاةَ فَلاَ صِيَامَ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ إِلاَّ اَلثَّلاَثَةَ اَلْأَيَّامِ اَلَّتِي قَالَ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فِي اَلْحَجِّ.

items.e: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal said: Ahmad ibn al-Hasan narrated to me, from his father, from al-Hasan ibn al-Jahm, who said: I (narrator) asked him about ‘a man who missed the fast of the three days during Hajj.’ He said: “Whoever misses the fasting of three days during Hajj, so long as he did not intentionally abandon it, then he fasts in Makkah as long as he has not left it. But if his camel-driver (jammal) refuses to stay for him, then let him fast on the road.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ اَلْجَهْمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ فَاتَهُ صَوْمُ اَلثَّلاَثَةِ اَلْأَيَّامِ فِي اَلْحَجِّ قَالَ» مَنْ فَاتَهُ صِيَامُ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ فِي اَلْحَجِّ مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ عَمْداً تَارِكاً فَإِنَّهُ يَصُومُ بِمَكَّةَ مَا لَمْ يَخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنْ أَبَى جَمَّالُهُ أَنْ يُقِيمَ عَلَيْهِ فَلْيَصُمْ فِي اَلطَّرِيقِ«.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid, from Yunus, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man performing tamattu (mutamatti) who did not have a sacrificial offering (hady) with him.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He fasts three days: one day before al-Tarwiyah, the Day of al-Tarwiyah, and the Day of Arafah.” He (narrator) said: “So I said to Imam (a.s), ‘When the Day of al-Tarwiyah enters, and it is not proper for him to fast in Mina during the days of al-Tashriq.’” Imam (a.s) said: “Then when he returns to Makkah, he fasts.” He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘But if his companions hasten him and refuse to stay in Makkah?’” Imam (a.s) said: “Then let him fast on the road.” He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘Then he fasts while travelling?’” Imam (a.s) said: “That is it; he fasts on the Day of Arafah, and the people of Arafah are travelling.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْوَلِيدِ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ مُتَمَتِّعٍ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَهُ هَدْيٌ قَالَ »يَصُومُ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ قَبْلَ اَلتَّرْوِيَةِ بِيَوْمٍ وَ يَوْمَ اَلتَّرْوِيَةِ وَ يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ« قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ إِذَا دَخَلَ يَوْمَ اَلتَّرْوِيَةِ وَ هُوَ لاَ يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يَصُومَ بِمِنًى أَيَّامَ اَلتَّشْرِيقِ قَالَ» فَإِذَا رَجَعَ إِلَى مَكَّةَ صَامَ« قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنْ أَعْجَلَهُ أَصْحَابُهُ وَأَبَوْا أَنْ يُقِيمُوا بِمَكَّةَ قَالَ» فَلْيَصُمْ فِي اَلطَّرِيقِ« قَالَ فَقُلْتُ فَيَصُومُ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ قَالَ» هُوَ ذَا هُوَ يَصُومُ فِي يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ وَ أَهْلُ عَرَفَةَ هُمْ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ«.
