items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal narrated that from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Whoever did not fast the three days during Hajj until the crescent (al-hilal) was sighted for him?” Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him is a blood-sacrifice which he pours forth, and there is no fasting upon him.”
items.o: رَوَى ذَلِكَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ اَلْبَخْتَرِيِّ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ مَنْ لَمْ يَصُمِ اَلثَّلاَثَةَ اَلْأَيَّامِ فِي اَلْحَجِّ حَتَّى يُهَلَّ عَلَيْهِ اَلْهِلاَلُ فَقَالَ» عَلَيْهِ دَمٌ يُهَرِيقُهُ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ صِيَامٌ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Ali ibn Asbat, from Alaa ibn Razin al-Qalla, from Muhammad ibn Muslim: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about ‘zihar’ concerning a free woman and a female slave.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.” He (narrator) said: “Then if he performs zihar in Shaban and does not find anything with which to free a slave?” – meaning as expiation for this sin. Imam (a.s) said: “He waits until he fasts (month of) Ramadan, then he fasts two consecutive months. And if he performs zihar while he is travelling, he breaks the fast until he arrives. And if he fasts, then comes upon wealth that he owns, then let him make up that which he began.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطٍ عَنْ عَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ اَلْقَلاَّءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلظِّهَارِ عَنِ اَلْحُرَّةِ وَ اَلْأَمَةِ قَالَ» نَعَمْ« قَالَ فَإِنْ ظَاهَرَ فِي شَعْبَانَ وَ لَمْ يَجِدْ مَا يُعْتِقُ قَالَ» يَنْتَظِرُ حَتَّى يَصُومَ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ يَصُومُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ وَ إِنْ ظَاهَرَ وَ هُوَ مُسَافِرٌ أَفْطَرَ حَتَّى يَقْدَمَ وَ إِنْ صَامَ فَأَصَابَ مَا لاً يَمْلِكُ فَلْيَقْضِ اَلَّذِي اِبْتَدَأَ فِيهِ«.

items.e: Imam (a.s) said: “If you stay in al-Madinah for three days, then fast on the first day, Wednesday, and pray on the night of Wednesday at the column of Abu Lubabah. It is the Column of Repentance (Ustuwanah al-Tawbah), to which he tied himself until his pardon was sent down from heaven. Remain by it on Wednesday. Then, on the following night, the night of Thursday, go to the place beside the station of the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and remain there for your night and your day. Fast on Thursday. Then, on the night of Friday, go to the column that is beside the station of the blessed Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and his prayer-place. Pray beside it throughout your night and your day, and fast on Friday. If you are able, during these days, not to speak about anything except what is necessary for you, not to leave the mosque except for a need, and not to sleep by night or by day, then do so, for that is among the things in which merit is counted. Then, on Friday, praise Allah (swt), extol Him (swt), send blessings upon the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and ask for your need. Let the following be among what you say: ‘O almighty Allah (swt), whatever need I have with You (swt), whether I have begun to seek it and request it or have not begun, whether I have asked You (swt) for it or have not asked You (swt) for it, I turn to You (swt) through Your Prophet Muhammad (saws), the Prophet of Mercy, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, for the fulfilment of my needs, the small of them and the great.’ For it is fitting that your need will be fulfilled, if Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), wills.”
items.o: مُوسَى بْنُ اَلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِنْ كَانَ لَكَ مُقَامٌ بِالْمَدِينَةِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ صُمْتَ أَوَّلَ يَوْمٍ اَلْأَرْبِعَاءَ وَ تُصَلِّي لَيْلَةَ اَلْأَرْبِعَاءِ عِنْدَ أُسْطُوَانَةِ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ وَ هِيَ أُسْطُوَانَةُ اَلتَّوْبَةِ اَلَّتِي كَانَ رَبَطَ إِلَيْهَا نَفْسَهُ حَتَّى نَزَلَ عُذْرُهُ مِنَ اَلسَّمَاءِ وَ تَقْعُدُ عِنْدَهَا يَوْمَ اَلْأَرْبِعَاءِ ثُمَّ تَأْتِي لَيْلَةَ اَلْخَمِيسِ اَلَّتِي تَلِيهَا مِمَّا يَلِي مَقَامَ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ لَيْلَتَكَ وَ يَوْمَكَ وَ تَصُومُ يَوْمَ اَلْخَمِيسِ ثُمَّ تَأْتِي اَلْأُسْطُوَانَةَ اَلَّتِي تَلِي مَقَامَ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَمُصَلاَّهُ لَيْلَةَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ فَتُصَلِّي عِنْدَهَا لَيْلَتَكَ وَ يَوْمَكَ وَ تَصُومُ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ إِنِ اِسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ لاَ تَتَكَلَّمَ بِشَيْءٍ فِي هَذِهِ اَلْأَيَّامِ إِلاَّ مَالاَ بُدَّلَكَ مِنْهُ وَ لاَ تَخْرُجَ مِنَ اَلْمَسْجِدِ إِلاَّ لِحَاجَةٍ وَ لاَ تَنَامَ فِي لَيْلٍ وَ لاَ نَهَارٍ فَافْعَلْ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ مِمَّا يُعَدُّ فِيهِ اَلْفَضْلُ ثُمَّ اِحْمَدِ اَللَّهَ فِي يَوْمِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ أَثْنِ عَلَيْهِ وَ صَلِّ عَلَى اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَ سَلْ حَاجَتَكَ وَلْيَكُنْ فِيمَا تَقُولُ اَللَّهُمَّ مَا كَانَتْ لِي إِلَيْكَ مِنْ حَاجَةٍ شَرَعْتُ أَنَا فِي طَلَبِهَا وَاِلْتِمَاسِهَا أَوْ لَمْ أَشْرَعْ سَأَلْتُكَهَا أَوْ لَمْ أَسْأَلْكَهَا فَإِنِّي أَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ بِنَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّ اَلرَّحْمَةِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فِي قَضَاءِ حَوَائِجِي صَغِيرِهَا وَكَبِيرِهَا فَإِنَّكَ حَرِيٌّ أَنْ تُقْضَى حَاجَتُكَ إِنْ شَاءَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Karam, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I have made it binding upon myself that I fast until the Qa’im (ajf), may Allah (swt) hasten his relief, rises.” Imam (a.s) said: “Fast, but do not fast while travelling, nor on the two Eids, nor on the days of tashriq (ayyam al-tashriq), nor on the day concerning which there is doubt whether it is from the month of Ramadan.”
items.o: محمد بن يعقوب عن علي بن إبراهيم عن أبيه عن ابن ابي عمير عن كرام قال: قلت لابي عبد الله عليه السلام اني جعلت على نفسي ان اصوم حتى يقوم القائم عجل الله فرجه فقال: صم ولا تصم في السفر ولا العيدين ولا ايام التشريق ولا اليوم الذي يشك فيه من شهر رمضان

items.e: And what also indicates it is what al-Husayn ibn Said narrated from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Jawhari, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Ibrahim (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who made it binding upon himself to fast a month in al-Kufah, a month in al-Madinah, and a month in Makkah because of an affliction with which he was afflicted. Then it was decreed for him that he fasted a month in al-Kufah and entered al-Madinah, where he fasted eighteen days, but the camel-driver (al-jammal) did not stay for him.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He fasts what remains upon him when he reaches his town.”
items.o: وَ يَدُلُّ عَلَيْهِ أَيْضاً مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْجَوْهَرِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ جَعَلَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ صَوْمَ شَهْرٍ بِالْكُوفَةِ وَ شَهْرٍ بِالْمَدِينَةِ وَ شَهْرٍ بِمَكَّةَ مِنْ بَلاَءٍ اُبْتُلِيَ بِهِ فَقُضِيَ لَهُ أَنَّهُ صَامَ بِالْكُوفَةِ شَهْراً وَ دَخَلَ إِلَى اَلْمَدِينَةِ فَصَامَ بِهَا ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ يَوْماً وَ لَمْ يُقِمْ عَلَيْهِ اَلْجَمَّالُ فَقَالَ» يَصُومُ مَا بَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ إِذَا اِنْتَهَى إِلَى بَلَدِهِ«.

items.e: And also what Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal narrated from Amr ibn Uthman, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who fasts a fast which he has appointed upon himself, or fasts the sacred months, then a month and two months pass by him without him making it up.’ He (narrator) said: “So Imam (a.s) said, ‘He does not fast while travelling, and he does not make up anything from voluntary fasting except the three days which he used to fast in every month. And he should not make it like the obligatory, except that I love for you to continue upon righteous action.” Imam (a.s) said: “And the one responsible for the sacred months which he used to fast, it suffices him to fast, in place of each month from the sacred months, three days.”
items.o: وَ أَيْضاً مَا رَوَاهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَصُومُ صَوْماً وَ قَدْ وَقَّتَهُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ أَوْ يَصُومُ أَشْهُرَ اَلْحُرُمِ فَيَمُرُّ بِهِ اَلشَّهْرُ وَاَلشَّهْرَ انِ لاَ يَقْضِيهِ قَالَ فَقَالَ» لاَ يَصُومُ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ وَلاَ يَقْضِي شَيْئاً مِنْ صَوْمِ اَلتَّطَوُّعِ إِلاَّ اَلثَّلاَثَةَ اَلْأَيَّامِ اَلَّتِي كَانَ يَصُومُهَا فِي كُلِّ شَهْرٍ وَ لاَ يَجْعَلْهَا بِمَنْزِلَةِ اَلْوَاجِبِ إِلاَّ أَنِّي أُحِبُّ لَكَ أَنْ تَدُومَ عَلَى اَلْعَمَلِ اَلصَّالِحِ« قَالَ »وَ صَاحِبُ اَلْحُرُمِ اَلَّتِي كَانَ يَصُومُهَا يُجْزِيهِ أَنْ يَصُومَ مَكَانَ كُلِّ شَهْرٍ مِنْ أَشْهُرِ اَلْحُرُمِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from al-Qasim ibn Abi al-Qasim al-Sayqal, who said: He (narrator) wrote to Imam (a.s): “O my master, a man vowed to fast every Friday, continuously, for as long as he remains, then that day coincided with the day of Eid al-Fitr, or Eid al-Adha, or the days of al-Tashriq, or he travelled, or he became ill. Is the fasting of that day upon him, or making it up, or what should he do, O my master?” Imam (a.s) wrote to him: “Allah (swt) has removed fasting from you in all of these days, and you fast one day in place of a day, if Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), wills.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْقَاسِمِ اَلصَّيْقَلِ قَالَ: كَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ يَا سَيِّدِي رَجُلٌ نَذَرَ أَنْ يَصُومَ كُلَّ جُمُعَةٍ دَائِماً مَا بَقِيَ فَوَافَقَ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمُ يَوْمَ عِيدِ فِطْرٍ أَوْ أَضْحًى أَوْ أَيَّامَ اَلتَّشْرِيقِ أَوْ سَفَرَ أَوْ مَرِضَ هَلْ عَلَيْهِ صَوْمُ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمِ أَوْ قَضَاؤُهُ أَوْ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ يَا سَيِّدِي فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ» قَدْ وَضَعَ اَللَّهُ عَنْكَ اَلصِّيَامَ فِي هَذِهِ اَلْأَيَّامِ كُلِّهَا وَتَصُومُ يَوْماً بَدَلَ يَوْمٍ إِنْ شَاءَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى«.

items.e: And what also indicates it is what Sa’ad ibn Abdullah narrated from Abu Jafar, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “My mother had made a vow upon herself that, if Allah (swt) returned to her one of her children from something she feared for him, she would fast that day on which he arrived, for as long as she remained. Then she went out with us, travelling to Makkah, and it became unclear to us because of the vow: should she fast or break the fast?” Imam (a.s) said: “She should not fast. Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, has removed His (swt) right from her, and she fasts what she made binding upon herself.” I (narrator) said: “Then what do you see, when she returns to the house, should she make it up?” Imam (a.s) said: “No.” I (narrator) asked: “Then should she leave that?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, for I fear that she may see, concerning the matter for which she made the vow, something she dislikes.”
items.o: وَ يَدُلُّ أَيْضاً عَلَيْهِ مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّ أُمِّي كَانَتْ جَعَلَتْ عَلَيْهَا نَذْراً إِنِ اَللَّهُ رَدَّ عَلَيْهَا بَعْضَ وُلْدِهَا مِنْ شَيْءٍ كَانَتْ تَخَافُ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ تَصُومَ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمَ اَلَّذِي يَقْدَمُ فِيهِ مَا بَقِيَتْ فَخَرَجَتْ مَعَنَا مُسَافِرَةً إِلَى مَكَّةَ فَأَشْكَلَ عَلَيْنَا لِمَكَانِ اَلنَّذْرِ أَ تَصُومُ أَمْ تُفْطِرُ فَقَالَ» لاَ تَصُومُ وَضَعَ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ عَنْهَا حَقَّهُ وَ تَصُومُ هِيَ مَا جَعَلَتْ عَلَى نَفْسِهَا« قُلْتُ فَمَا تَرَى إِذَا هِيَ رَجَعَتْ إِلَى اَلْمَنْزِلِ أَتَقْضِيهِ قَالَ» لاَ« قُلْتُ أَفَتَتْرُكُ ذَلِكَ قَالَ» لاَ لِأَنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ تَرَى فِي اَلَّذِي نَذَرَتْ فِيهِ مَا تَكْرَهُ«.

items.e: As for what Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal narrated from Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Abi al-Sabbah, from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who makes a fast of a specified day binding upon himself for Allah (swt).’ Imam (a.s) said: “He fasts it always, while present and while travelling.”
items.o: وَ أَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلصَّبَّاحِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَجْعَلُ لِلَّهِ عَلَيْهِ صَوْمَ يَوْمٍ مُسَمًّى قَالَ» يَصُومُهُ أَبَداً فِي اَلْحَضَرِ وَ اَلسَّفَرِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, who said: Bundar, the client of Idris, wrote: “O my master, I vowed to fast every Saturday. If I do not fast it, what expiation becomes binding upon me?” So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote, and I (narrator) read it: “Do not abandon it except due to an illness, and fasting it is not upon you while travelling nor in illness, unless you had intended that. So if you have broken the fast from it without an illness, then give charity, for each day, to seven poor persons. We ask Allah (swt) for success in what He (swt) loves and is pleased with.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: كَتَبَ بُنْدَارُ مَوْلَى إِدْرِيسَ يَا سَيِّدِي نَذَرْتُ أَنْ أَصُومَ كُلَّ يَوْمِ سَبْتٍ فَإِنْ أَنَا لَمْ أَصُمْهُ مَا يَلْزَمُنِي مِنَ اَلْكَفَّارَةِ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» وَ قَرَأْتُهُ لاَ تَتْرُكْهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ عِلَّةٍ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ صَوْمُهُ فِي سَفَرٍ وَ لاَ مَرَضٍ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ نَوَيْتَ ذَلِكَ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ أَفْطَرْتَ مِنْهُ فِي غَيْرِ عِلَّةٍ فَتَصَدَّقْ بِقَدْرِ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ عَلَى سَبْعَةِ مَسَاكِينَ نَسْأَلُ اَللَّهَ اَلتَّوْفِيقَ لِمَا يُحِبُّ وَيَرْضَى«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘fasting in Makkah and al-Madinah while we are travelling.’ Imam (a.s) said: “An obligation?” So I (narrator) asked: “No, but rather it is voluntary, just as prayer is performed voluntarily.” Imam (a.s) said: “You say, ‘Today and tomorrow’?” I (narrator) asked: “Yes.” Imam (a.s) said: “Do not fast.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَ عَنِ اَلصِّيَامِ بِمَكَّةَ وَ اَلْمَدِينَةِ وَ نَحْنُ فِي سَفَرٍ قَالَ »فَرِيضَةٌ« فَقُلْتُ لاَ وَ لَكِنَّهُ تَطَوُّعٌ كَمَا يُتَطَوَّعُ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ» تَقُولُ اَلْيَوْمَ وَ غَداً« قُلْتُ نَعَمْ فَقَالَ» لاَ تَصُمْ«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Zurarah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah’s (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, would not fast while travelling, neither in the month of Ramadan nor in other than it. And the Day of Badr was in the month of Ramadan, and the Conquest was in the month of Ramadan.”
items.o: وَ رَوَى سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لَمْ يَكُنْ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ يَصُومُ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ لاَ غَيْرِهِ وَ كَانَ يَوْمُ بَدْرٍ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ كَانَ اَلْفَتْحُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Mansur ibn al-Abbas, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Rafi, from Ismail ibn Sahl, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (a.s): Abu Abdillah (a.s) left Madinah during days remaining from Shaban, and he was fasting. Then the month of Ramadan entered upon the Imam (a.s) while he was travelling, so the Imam (a.s) broke the fast. It was said to Imam (a.s): “Do you fast Shaban and break the fast in the month of Ramadan?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes. Shaban is up to me; if I wish, I fast it, and if I wish, I do not. But the month of Ramadan is a firm obligation from Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, to break the fast.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ سَهْلٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ ع قَالَ: خَرَجَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ ع مِنَ اَلْمَدِينَةِ فِي أَيَّامٍ بَقِينَ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ فَكَانَ يَصُومُ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ وَ هُوَ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ فَأَفْطَرَ فَقِيلَ لَهُ أَ تَصُومُ شَعْبَانَ وَ تُفْطِرُ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ فَقَالَ» نَعَمْ شَعْبَانُ إِلَيَّ إِنْ شِئْتُ صُمْتُهُ وَإِنْ شِئْتُ لاَ وَشَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ عَزْمٌ مِنَ اَللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ عَلَى اَلْإِفْطَارِ«.

items.e: And from him, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Bilal, from al-Hasan ibn Bassam al-Jammal, from a man, who said: I (narrator) was with Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, between Makkah and al-Madinah in Shaban, while Imam (a.s) was fasting. Then we saw the crescent of the month of Ramadan, so Imam (a.s) broke the fast. I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “May I be made your ransom, yesterday was from Shaban and you were fasting, and today is from the month of Ramadan and you are breaking the fast.” Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, that is voluntary, and we may do whatever we wish, but this is obligatory, so we may not do except what we have been commanded.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ بَسَّامٍ اَلْجَمَّالِ عَنْ رَجُلٍ قَالَ: كُنْتُ مَعَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِيمَا بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَاَلْمَدِينَةِ فِي شَعْبَانَ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ ثُمَّ رَأَيْنَا هِلاَلَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَأَفْطَرَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ أَمْسِ كَانَ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ وَ أَنْتَ صَائِمٌ وَ اَلْيَوْمُ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ أَنْتَ مُفْطِرٌ فَقَالَ» إِنَّ ذَاكَ تَطَوُّعٌ وَ لَنَا أَنْ نَفْعَلَ مَا شِئْنَا وَ هَذَا فَرْضٌ فَلَيْسَ لَنَا أَنْ نَفْعَلَ إِلاَّ مَا أُمِرْنَا«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘an elderly man who is too weak to fast the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He gives in charity what suffices on his behalf: the food of one poor person for each day (of missed fast).”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ كَبِيرٍ يَضْعُفُ عَنْ صَوْمِ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَقَالَ» يَتَصَدَّقُ بِمَا يُجْزِي عَنْهُ طَعَامِ مِسْكِينٍ لِكُلِّ يَوْمٍ«.
items.h: Chapter on One Incapable of Fasting

items.e: And from him, from Fadalah, from al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding the saying of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, “(And upon those who are able to bear it) compensation can be made by feeding a needy person (for every day not fasted),” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:184) Imam (a.s) said: “The elderly man and the one who is afflicted by excessive thirst (al-utash).” And regarding the saying of Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt): “But if he is unable (to fast), then let him feed sixty poor people,” (Surah Al-Mujadilah 58:4) Imam (a.s) said: “Due to illness or excessive thirst (utash).”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي قَوْلِ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ» وَ عَلَى اَلَّذِينَ يُطِيقُونَهُ فِدْيَةٌ طَعٰامُ مِسْكِينٍ« قَالَ» اَلشَّيْخُ اَلْكَبِيرُ وَ اَلَّذِي يَأْخُذُهُ اَلْعُطَاشُ« وَ عَنْ قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى» فَمَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَإِطْعٰامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِيناً« قَالَ» مِنْ مَرَضٍ أَوْ عُطَاشٍ«.

items.e: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abd al-Malik ibn Utbah al-Hashimi, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the elderly man and the elderly woman who are too weak to fast in the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “She gives in charity, on behalf of each day, a mudd of wheat.”
items.o: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ اَلْهَاشِمِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلشَّيْخِ اَلْكَبِيرِ وَاَلْعَجُوزِ اَلْكَبِيرَةِ اَلَّتِي تَضْعُفُ عَنِ اَلصَّوْمِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ قَالَ» تَتَصَدَّقُ عَنْ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ بِمُدٍّ مِنْ حِنْطَةٍ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said: I (narrator) heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “The elderly man and the one who has excessive thirst (al-utash), there is no difficulty upon them if they break the fast in the month of Ramadan, and each one of them gives in charity, for each day, a mudd of food, and there is no making up (of fasts) upon them. But if they are not able, then there is nothing upon them.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» اَلشَّيْخُ اَلْكَبِيرُ وَ اَلَّذِي بِهِ اَلْعُطَاشُ لاَ حَرَجَ عَلَيْهِمَا أَنْ يُفْطِرَا فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ يَتَصَدَّقَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ بِمُدٍّ مِنْ طَعَامٍ وَ لاَ قَضَاءَ عَلَيْهِمَا فَإِنْ لَمْ يَقْدِرَا فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِمَا«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah narrated this hadith from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, who said: Jafar ibn Bashir and Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Hilal narrated to us, from Alaa ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said: I (narrator) heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him; and he (narrator) mentioned the hadith, except that Imam (a.s) said: “And each one of them gives in charity, for each day, two mudds (muddayn) of food.”
items.o: وَرَوَى هَذَا اَلْحَدِيثَ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْخَطَّابِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ عَنْ عَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: وَذَكَرَ اَلْحَدِيثَ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ» وَ يَتَصَدَّقُ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ بِمُدَّيْنِ مِنَ اَلطَّعَامِ«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Imran ibn Musa and Ali ibn Khalid, from Harun, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Yahya ibn al-Mubarak, from Abdullah ibn Jundab, from Samaah ibn Mihran, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “The elderly man is not able to fast.” Imam (a.s) said: “Some of his children fast on his behalf.” I (narrator) asked: “But if he has no children?” Imam (a.s) said: “Then his nearest relative.” I (narrator) asked: “But if he has no relative?” Imam (a.s) said: “He gives a mudd in charity for each day. But if he does not have anything with him, then there is nothing upon him.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى وَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ اَلْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ اَلشَّيْخُ اَلْكَبِيرُ لاَ يَقْدِرُ أَنْ يَصُومَ فَقَالَ» يَصُومُ عَنْهُ بَعْضُ وُلْدِهِ« قُلْتُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وُلْدٌ قَالَ» فَأَدْنَى قَرَابَتِهِ« قُلْتُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ قَرَابَةٌ قَالَ» تَصَدَّقَ بِمُدٍّ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ عِنْدَهُ شَيْءٌ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Dawud ibn Farqad, from his father, who said: Hafs al-Awar wrote to me: “Ask Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about three matters.” So Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “What are they?” He (narrator) said: “One who abandoned fasting three days in a month.” Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Due to illness, or old age, or thirst?” He (narrator) replied: “Then explain to me each matter separately.” Imam (a.s) said: “If it was due to illness, then when he recovers, let him make it up (the fasts). And if it was due to old age or thirst, then in place of each day is one mudd.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ فَرْقَدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: كَتَبَ حَفْصٌ اَلْأَعْوَرُ إِلَيَّ سَلْ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ ثَلاَثِ مَسَائِلَ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» مَا هِيَ« قَالَ مَنْ تَرَكَ صِيَامَ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ فِي شَهْرٍ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» مِنْ مَرَضٍ أَوْ كِبَرٍ أَوْ لِعَطَشٍ« قَالَ فَاشْرَحْ لِي شَيْئاً شَيْئاً فَقَالَ» إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ مَرَضٍ فَإِذَا بَرَأَ فَلْيَقْضِهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ كِبَرٍ أَوْ لِعَطَشٍ فَبَدَلُ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ مُدٌّ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahbub, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said: I (narrator) heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “The pregnant woman near delivery (al-hamil al-muqrib) and the breastfeeding woman with little milk, there is no difficulty upon them if they break the fast in the month of Ramadan, because they are not able to bear the fast. And it is upon them that each one of them gives in charity, for each day in which she breaks the fast, a mudd of food. And upon them is the making up of every day in which they broke the fast; they make it up afterwards.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» اَلْحَامِلُ اَلْمُقْرِبُ وَاَلْمُرْضِعُ اَلْقَلِيلَةُ اَللَّبَنِ لاَ حَرَجَ عَلَيْهِمَا أَنْ تُفْطِرَا فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ لِأَنَّهُمَا لاَ تُطِيقَانِ اَلصَّوْمَ وَ عَلَيْهِمَا أَنْ تَتَصَدَّقَ كُلُّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُمَا فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ تُفْطِرُ فِيهِ بِمُدٍّ مِنْ طَعَامٍ وَ عَلَيْهِمَا قَضَاءُ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَفْطَرَتَا فِيهِ تَقْضِيَانِهِ بَعْدُ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn al-Husayn, from Amr ibn Said, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who is afflicted by thirst until he fears for himself.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He drinks the amount by which he preserves his life (ramaq), and he does not drink until he is quenched.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُصِيبُهُ اَلْعَطَشُ حَتَّى يَخَافَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ قَالَ» يَشْرَبُ بِقَدْرِ مَا يُمْسِكُ رَمَقَهُ وَ لاَ يَشْرَبُ حَتَّى يَرْوَى«.

items.e: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from Mufaddal ibn Umar, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “We have young men and girls who are not able to fast because of the severity of what afflicts them of thirst.” Imam (a.s) said: “Then let them drink the amount by which their souls are relieved and what they fear is averted.”
items.o: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مَرَّارٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ مُفَضَّلِ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّ لَنَا فِتْيَاناً وَبَنَاتٍ لاَ يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَى اَلصِّيَامِ مِنْ شِدَّةِ مَا يُصِيبُهُمْ مِنَ اَلْعَطَشِ قَالَ» فَلْيَشْرَبُوا مِقْدَارَ مَا تَرْوَى بِهِ نُفُوسُهُمْ وَ مَا يَحْذَرُونَ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abi al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam (a.s) said: “When a man travels in the month of Ramadan, he must not approach women during the day in (month of) Ramadan, for that (intimacy) is forbidden for him.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِذَا سَافَرَ اَلرَّجُلُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَلاَ يَقْرَبِ اَلنِّسَاءَ بِالنَّهَارِ فِي رَمَضَانَ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ مُحَرَّمٌ عَلَيْهِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Ibn Sinan, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who travels in the month of Ramadan and has with him a slave-girl belonging to him, whether he may have intercourse with her during the day.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Glory be to Allah (swt)! Does this one not know the sanctity of the month of Ramadan? Indeed, he has a long expanse in the night.” I (narrator) asked: “Does he not have the right to eat, drink, and shorten the prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, has granted the traveler a concession in breaking the fast and shortening the prayer, as a mercy and an easing because of the place of fatigue, hardship, and the roughness of travel, but Allah (swt) has not granted him a concession in having intercourse with women during travel by day in the month of Ramadan. And Allah (swt) has made obligatory upon him the making up of the fast, but Allah (swt) has not made obligatory upon him the completing of the prayer when he returns from his travel.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “And the Sunnah is not measured by analogy, and when I travel in the month of Ramadan, I do not eat except (minimal) sustenance, and I do not drink (excessively) to full quenching.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُسَافِرُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ مَعَهُ جَارِيَةٌ لَهُ فَلَهُ أَنْ يُصِيبَ مِنْهَا بِالنَّهَارِ فَقَالَ» سُبْحَانَ اَللَّهِ أَ مَا يَعْرِفُ هَذَا حُرْمَةَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ إِنَّ لَهُ فِي اَللَّيْلِ سَبْحاً طَوِيلاً« قُلْتُ أَ لَيْسَ لَهُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ وَ يَشْرَبَ وَ يُقَصِّرَ فَقَالَ» إِنَّ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ رَخَّصَ لِلْمُسَافِرِ فِي اَلْإِفْطَارِ وَ اَلتَّقْصِيرِ رَحْمَةً وَ تَخْفِيفاً لِمَوْضِعِ اَلتَّعَبِ وَ اَلنَّصَبِ وَوَعْثِ اَلسَّفَرِ وَ لَمْ يُرَخِّصْ لَهُ فِي مُجَامَعَةِ اَلنِّسَاءِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ بِالنَّهَارِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ أَوْجَبَ عَلَيْهِ قَضَاءَ اَلصِّيَامِ وَ لَمْ يُوجِبْ عَلَيْهِ تَمَامَ اَلصَّلاَةِ إِذَا آبَ مِنْ سَفَرِهِ« ثُمَّ قَالَ» وَ اَلسُّنَّةُ لاَ تُقَاسُ وَ إِنِّي إِذَا سَافَرْتُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مَا آكُلُ إِلاَّ اَلْقُوتَ وَ مَا أَشْرَبُ كُلَّ اَلرِّيِّ«.

items.e: And from him, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Ahmar, from Abdullah ibn Hammad, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who comes to his slave-girl (for intimacy) during the day in the month of Ramadan while travelling.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Does this one not know the right of the month of Ramadan? Indeed, he has a long expanse in the night.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ اَلْأَحْمَرِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَأْتِي جَارِيَتَهُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ بِالنَّهَارِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ فَقَالَ» أَ مَا يَعْرِفُ هَذَا حَقَّ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ إِنَّ لَهُ فِي اَللَّيْلِ سَبْحاً طَوِيلاً«.

items.e: As for what Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated, from Muhammad ibn Sahl, from his father, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who came to his wife (for intimacy) in the month of Ramadan while he was travelling.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَتَى أَهْلَهُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ هُوَ مُسَافِرٌ فَقَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ«.

items.e: And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Umar ibn Yazid, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who travels in the month of Ramadan, does he have the right to have intercourse with women?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُسَافِرُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَ لَهُ أَنْ يُصِيبَ مِنَ اَلنِّسَاءِ قَالَ» نَعَمْ«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abd al-Malik ibn Utbah al-Hashimi, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man having intercourse with his wife while travelling in the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in it.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ اَلْهَاشِمِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُجَامِعُ أَهْلَهُ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَقَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who arrives from a journey after the afternoon prayer in the month of Ramadan, and then comes to his wife (for intimacy) when she has become pure from menstruation. May he have intercourse with her?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَقْدَمُ مِنْ سَفَرٍ بَعْدَ اَلْعَصْرِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَيُصِيبُ اِمْرَأَتَهُ حِينَ طَهُرَتْ مِنَ اَلْحَيْضِ أَيُوَاقِعُهَا قَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, who said: I (narrator) wrote to Abu al-Hasan al-Thalith (a.s) (the Third), peace be upon him, asking Imam (a.s) about ‘one who is unconscious for a day or more, does he make up what he missed or not?’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “He does not make up the fast, and he does not make up the prayer.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَ يُّوبَ بْ نِ نُوحٍ قَا لَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلثَّالِثِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَ سْأَلُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ يَوْماً أَوْ أَكْثَرَ هَلْ يَقْضِي مَا فَاتَهُ أَ مْ لاَ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» لاَ يَقْضِي اَلصَّوْمَ وَ لاَ يَقْضِي اَلصَّلاَةَ«.
items.h: Chapter on Ruling of the Unconscious Person, the One Afflicted with Bile (Sahib al-Mirrah]) and the Insane Person Regarding Prayer and Fasting

items.e: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qasani, who said: I (narrator) wrote to the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, while I was in Madinah, asking Imam (a.s) about ‘one who is unconscious for a day or more, does he make up what he missed?’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “He does not make up the fast.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْقَاسَانِيِّ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ أَنَا بِالْمَدِينَةِ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ يَوْماً أَوْ أَكْثَرَ هَلْ يَقْضِي مَا فَاتَهُ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» لاَ يَقْضِي اَلصَّوْمَ«.

items.e: Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who is unconscious for days.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He does not repeat anything of his prayer.”
items.o: حَرِيزٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ اَلْأَيَّامَ قَالَ» لاَ يُعِيدُ شَيْئاً مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘one who is unconscious for a day or more, does he make up what he missed of the prayer or not?’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “He does not make up the fast, and he does not make up the prayer.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْجَبَّارِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ يَوْماً أَوْ أَكْثَرَ هَلْ يَقْضِي مَا فَاتَهُ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ أَمْ لاَ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» لاَ يَقْضِي اَلصَّوْمَ وَ لاَ يَقْضِي اَلصَّلاَةَ«.

items.e: As for what Ibn Abi Umayr narrated, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam (a.s) said: “The one who is unconscious makes up the prayer of three days.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اِبْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ اَلْبَخْتَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ يَقْضِي صَلاَةَ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ«.

items.e: Hafs, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam (a.s) said: “The one who is unconscious makes up what he missed.”
items.o: حَفْصٌ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» يَقْضِي اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ مَا فَاتَهُ«.

items.e: Hafs, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam (a.s) said: “He makes up the prayer of one day.”
items.o: حَفْصٌ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» يَقْضِي صَلاَةَ يَوْمٍ«.

items.e: Hafs, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam (a.s) said: “He makes up the prayer during which he regained consciousness.”
items.o: حَفْصٌ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» يَقْضِي اَلصَّلاَةَ اَلَّتِي أَفَاقَ فِيهَا«.

items.e: Ibn Abi Umayr, from Rifaa, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘one who is unconscious for a month, what does he make up of the prayer?’ Imam (a.s) said: “He makes all of it up. Indeed, the matter of prayer is severe.”
items.o: اِبْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ شَهْراً مَا يَقْضِي مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ» يَقْضِيهَا كُلَّهَا إِنَّ أَمْرَ اَلصَّلاَةِ شَدِيدٌ«.

items.e: Al-Hasan, from Zuraa, from Samaa, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a sick person who becomes unconscious.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If it is less than three days, then there is no making up upon him; and if he is made unconscious for three days, then upon him is the making up of the prayer in them.”
items.o: اَلْحَسَنُ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَرِيضِ يُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ قَالَ» إِذَا كَانَ دُونَ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ قَضَاءٌ وَ إِذَا أُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَعَلَيْهِ قَضَاءُ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِيهِنَّ«.

items.e: Al-Nadr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam (a.s) said: “Everything that you have left of your prayers because of an illness in which you were made unconscious, make it up when you regain consciousness.”
items.o: اَلنَّضْرُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» كُلُّ شَيْءٍ تَرَكْتَهُ مِنْ صَلَوَاتِكَ لِمَرَضٍ أُغْمِيَ عَلَيْكَ فِيهِ فَاقْضِهِ إِذَا أَفَقْتَ«.

items.e: Safwan, from al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who becomes unconscious and then regains consciousness.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He makes up what he missed, and he gives the call to prayer for the first one and gives the iqamah for the rest.”
items.o: صَفْوَانُ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُفِيقُ قَالَ» يَقْضِي مَا فَاتَهُ وَ يُؤَذِّنُ فِي اَلْأُولَى وَ يُقِيمُ فِي اَلْبَقِيَّةِ«.

items.e: Hariz, from Abu Basir, who said: I (narrator) said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man was made unconscious for a month; does he make up anything of his prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “He makes up three days of it.”
items.o: حَرِيزٌ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ أُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ شَهْراً أَ يَقْضِي مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ شَيْئاً قَالَ »يَقْضِي مِنْهَا ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ«.

items.e: Hammad, from Abu Kahmas, who said: I (narrator) heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, when Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘one who is unconscious, does he make up what he left of the prayer?’ Imam (a.s) said: “As for me, my children, and my family, we do that.” – meaning make up the prayer.
items.o: حَمَّادٌ عَنْ أَبِي كَهْمَسٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: وَ سُئِلَ عَنِ اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ أَ يَقْضِي مَا تَرَكَ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ» أَمَّا أَنَا وَ وُلْدِي وَ أَهْلِي فَنَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ«.

items.e: Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from more than one person, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: He (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘one who is unconscious for a month or forty nights.’ He (narrator) said: “So Imam (a.s) said, ‘If you wish, I will inform you of what I command myself and my children with: that you make up everything that you missed.’”
items.o: إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ غَيْرِ وَاحِدٍ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَهُ عَنِ اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ شَهْراً أَوْ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً قَالَ فَقَالَ »إِنْ شِئْتَ أَخْبَرْتُكَ بِمَا آمُرُ بِهِ نَفْسِي وَ وُلْدِي أَنْ تَقْضِيَ كُلَّمَا فَاتَكَ«.

items.e: Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam (a.s) said: “Everything over which Allah (swt) has overcome a person, there is nothing upon its possessor.”
items.o: إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: »كُلُّمَا غَلَبَ اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فَلَيْسَ عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ شَيْءٌ«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s): Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a man who accepted Islam in the middle of the month of Ramadan, what fasting is upon him?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Nothing is upon him except that in which he accepted Islam.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَسْلَمَ فِي اَلنِّصْفِ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مَا عَلَيْهِ مِنْ صِيَامٍ قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ مَا أَسْلَمَ فِيهِ«.
items.h: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It

items.e: And from him, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Is ibn al-Qasim, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a people who accepted Islam in the month of Ramadan while some days of it had already passed. Is it upon them to make up what had passed of it, or their day on which they accepted Islam?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no making up upon them, nor their day on which they accepted Islam, unless they had accepted Islam before the rising of dawn.”
items.o: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْعِيصِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ قَوْمٍ أَسْلَمُوا فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ قَدْ مَضَى مِنْهُ أَيَّامٌ هَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ أَنْ يَقْضُوا مَا مَضَى مِنْهُ أَوْ يَوْمَهُمُ اَلَّذِي أَسْلَمُوا فِيهِ قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِمْ قَضَاءٌ وَ لاَ يَوْمُهُمْ اَلَّذِي أَسْلَمُوا فِيهِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونُوا قَدْ أَسْلَمُوا قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ اَلْفَجْرِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Harun ibn Muslim, from Masada ibn Sadaqa, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his fathers (a.s), peace be upon them: Imam (a.s) said: “Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, used to say, regarding a man who accepted Islam in the middle of the month of Ramadan; ‘nothing is upon him except what he faces going forward.’”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ مَسْعَدَةَ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ كَانَ يَقُولُ:» فِي رَجُلٍ أَسْلَمَ فِي اَلنِّصْفِ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ مَا يَسْتَقْبِلُ«.

items.e: And that which al-Husayn ibn Said narrated, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Aban ibn Uthman, from al-Halabi, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who accepted Islam after some days had entered into the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Let him make up what he missed.”
items.o: وَاَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَسْلَمَ بَعْدَ مَا دَخَلَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَيَّاماً فَقَالَ» لِيَقْضِ مَا فَاتَهُ«.

items.e: What indicates that is what Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mualla ibn Muhammad, from al-Washsha, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from one whom he mentioned, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who dies while a debt from the month of Ramadan is upon him, who makes it up on his behalf?’ Imam (a.s) said: “The person most entitled to him.” I (narrator) asked: “Then if the person most entitled to him is a woman?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, only the men.”
items.o: يَدُلُّ عَلَى ذَلِكَ مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَلَّى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْوَشَّاءِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَمَّنْ ذَكَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ وَ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مَنْ يَقْضِي عَنْهُ قَالَ» أَوْلَى اَلنَّاسِ بِهِ« قُلْتُ فَإِنْ كَانَ أَوْلَى اَلنَّاسِ بِهِ اِمْرَأَةً قَالَ» لاَ إِلاَّ اَلرِّجَالُ«.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad, who said: I (narrator) wrote to the ‘Al Akhir’, the ‘Last One’ (a.s), peace be upon him, regarding ‘a man who died while upon him was the making up of ten days from the month of Ramadan, and he has two guardians. Is it permissible for both of them to make it up on his behalf together, five days by one of the two guardians and five days by the other?’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, signed: “The eldest of his two guardians makes up ten consecutive days on his behalf, if Allah (swt) wills.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى اَلْأَخِيرِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَ عَلَيْهِ قَضَاءٌ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ عَشَرَةَ أَيَّامٍ وَ لَهُ وَلِيَّانِ هَلْ يَجُوزُ لَهُمَا أَنْ يَقْضِيَا عَنْهُ جَمِيعاً خَمْسَةَ أَيَّامٍ أَحَدُ اَلْوَلِيَّيْنِ وَ خَمْسَةَ أَيَّامٍ اَلْآخَرُ فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» يَقْضِي عَنْهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلِيَّيْهِ عَشَرَةَ أَيَّامٍ وِلاَءً إِنْ شَاءَ اَللَّهُ«.

items.e: As for what Sa’ad ibn Abdullah narrated, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaa ibn Mihran, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man upon whom the month of Ramadan entered while he was sick and unable to fast, then he died in the month of Ramadan or in the month of Shawwal.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no fasting upon him and no making up on his behalf.” I (narrator) asked: “Then a woman in postnatal bleeding, upon whom the month of Ramadan entered while she was unable to fast, then she died in the month of Ramadan or in Shawwal?” Imam (a.s) said: “It is not made up on her behalf.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْخَطَّابِ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ وَ هُوَ مَرِيضٌ لاَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى اَلصِّيَامِ فَمَاتَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَوْ فِي شَهْرِ شَوَّالٍ قَالَ» لاَ صِيَامَ عَلَيْهِ وَ لاَ قَضَاءَ عَنْهُ« قُلْتُ فَامْرَأَةٌ نُفَسَاءُ دَخَلَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ عَلَيْهَا وَ لَمْ تَقْدِرْ عَلَى اَلصَّوْمِ فَمَاتَتْ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَوْ فِي شَوَّالٍ فَقَالَ» لاَ يُقْضَى عَنْهَا«.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Sayf ibn Amira, from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the sick person in the month of Ramadan who does not recover until he dies.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is not made up on his behalf.” (Imam (a.s) was asked) about ‘the menstruating woman who dies in the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is not made up on her behalf.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمَرِيضِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَلاَ يَصِحُّ حَتَّى يَمُوتَ قَالَ» لاَ يُقْضَى عَنْهُ« وَاَلْحَائِضِ تَمُوتُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ قَالَ» لاَ يُقْضَى عَنْهَا«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Zarif ibn Nasih, from Abu Maryam, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam (a.s) said: “If a man fasts something of the month of Ramadan, then remains sick until he dies, then there is nothing upon him. And if he recovers, then becomes sick until he dies, and he had wealth, charity is given on his behalf. But if he did not have wealth, his guardian gives charity on his behalf.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ ظَرِيفِ بْنِ نَاصِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِذَا صَامَ اَلرَّجُلُ شَيْئاً مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ مَرِيضاً حَتَّى يَمُوتَ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ وَ إِنْ صَحَّ ثُمَّ مَرِضَ حَتَّى يَمُوتَ وَ كَانَ لَهُ مَالٌ تُصُدِّقَ عَنْهُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَالٌ تَصَدَّقَ عَنْهُ وَلِيُّهُ«.

items.e: And in the narration of Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mualla ibn Muhammad, from al-Washsha, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abu Maryam: The like of that (in hadith 735), except that Imam (a.s) said: “His guardian fasts on his behalf.”
items.o: وَفِي رِوَايَةِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَلَّى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْوَشَّاءِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ: مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ» صَامَ عَنْهُ وَلِيُّهُ«.

items.e: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a woman who became sick in (month of) Ramadan and died in the month of Shawwal, and she instructed me to make it up on her behalf.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Did she recover from her illness?” I (narrator) said: “No, she died in it.” Imam (a.s) said: “It is not made up on her behalf, for Allah (swt) did not place it upon her.” I (narrator) asked: “But I desire to make it up on her behalf, and she instructed me to do that.” Imam (a.s) said: “So how can you make up something which Allah (swt) did not place upon her? If you desire to fast for yourself, then fast.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اِمْرَأَةٍ مَرِضَتْ فِي رَمَضَانَ وَ مَاتَتْ فِي شَهْرِ شَوَّالٍ فَأَوْصَتْنِي أَنْ أَقْضِيَ عَنْهَا قَالَ» هَلْ بَرَأَتْ مِنْ مَرَضِهَا« قُلْتُ لاَ مَاتَتْ فِيهِ قَالَ» لاَ يُقْضَى عَنْهَا فَإِنَّ اَللَّهَ لَمْ يَجْعَلْهُ عَلَيْهَا« قُلْتُ فَإِنِّي أَشْتَهِي أَنْ أَقْضِيَ عَنْهَا وَ قَدْ أَوْصَتْنِي بِذَلِكَ قَالَ» فَكَيْفَ تَقْضِي شَيْئاً لَمْ يَجْعَلْهُ اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهَا فَإِنِ اِشْتَهَيْتَ أَنْ تَصُومَ لِنَفْسِكَ فَصُمْ«.

items.e: And also what Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who was overtaken by the month of Ramadan while he was sick, then he died before recovering.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing upon him, but it is made up on behalf of the one who recovers and then dies before making it up.”
items.o: وَ أَيْضاً مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَدْرَكَهُ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ وَ هُوَ مَرِيضٌ فَتُوُفِّيَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَبْرَأَ قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ وَ لَكِنْ يُقْضَى عَنِ اَلَّذِي يَبْرَأُ ثُمَّ يَمُوتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ«.

items.e: And also what Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal narrated, from Muhammad and Ahmad, the two sons of al-Hasan, from their father, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who dies in the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is not upon his guardian to make up on his behalf what remains of the month. And if he became sick and did not fast (month of) Ramadan, then continued to be sick until (month of) Ramadan passed while he was sick, then died in that illness of his, then it is not upon his guardian to make up the fasting on his behalf. But if he became sick and did not fast the month of Ramadan, then recovered after that and did not make it up, then became sick and died, then it is upon his guardian to make it up on his behalf, because he had recovered and did not make it up, and it became obligatory upon him.”
items.o: وَ أَيْضاً مَا رَوَاهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَحْمَدَ اِبْنَيِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَى وَلِيِّهِ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ عَنْهُ مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ اَلشَّهْرِ وَإِنْ مَرِضَ فَلَمْ يَصُمْ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَزَلْ مَرِيضاً حَتَّى مَضَى رَمَضَانُ وَهُوَ مَرِيضٌ ثُمَّ مَاتَ فِي مَرَضِهِ ذَلِكَ فَلَيْسَ عَلَى وَلِيِّهِ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ عَنْهُ اَلصِّيَامَ فَإِنْ مَرِضَ فَلَمْ يَصُمْ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ صَحَّ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَلَمْ يَقْضِهِ ثُمَّ مَرِضَ فَمَاتَ فَعَلَى وَلِيِّهِ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ عَنْهُ لِأَنَّهُ قَدْ صَحَّ فَلَمْ يَقْضِ وَ وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn al-Rabi, from Sayf ibn Amira, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who travels in the month of Ramadan and dies.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is made up on his behalf. And if a woman menstruates in (month of) Ramadan and dies, it is not made up on her behalf. And the sick person in (month of) Ramadan who did not recover until he died, it is not made up on his behalf.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلرَّبِيعِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُسَافِرُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَيَمُوتُ قَالَ» يُقْضَى عَنْهُ وَ إِنِ اِمْرَأَةٌ حَاضَتْ فِي رَمَضَانَ فَمَاتَتْ لَمْ يُقْضَ عَنْهَا وَ اَلْمَرِيضُ فِي رَمَضَانَ لَمْ يَصِحَّ حَتَّى مَاتَ لَمْ يُقْضَ عَنْهُ«.

items.e: And from him, from Ali ibn Asbat, from Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a woman who became sick in the month of Ramadan, or menstruated, or travelled, then died before (month of) Ramadan ended. Is it made up on her behalf?’ Imam (a.s) said: “As for menstruation and sickness, no; but as for travel, yes.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطٍ عَنْ عَلاَءٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اِمْرَأَةٍ مَرِضَتْ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَوْ طَمِثَتْ أَوْ سَافَرَتْ فَمَاتَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ رَمَضَانُ هَلْ يُقْضَى عَنْهَا فَقَالَ» أَمَّا اَلطَّمْثُ وَ اَلْمَرَضُ فَلاَ وَ أَمَّا اَلسَّفَرُ فَنَعَمْ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) heard Imam (a.s) saying: “When a man dies while two consecutive months of fasting are upon him because of an illness, then upon him is that charity be given on behalf of the first month, and that the second be made up on his behalf.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْوَشَّاءِ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ:» إِذَا مَاتَ رَجُلٌ وَ عَلَيْهِ صِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مِنْ عِلَّةٍ فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَتَصَدَّقَ عَنِ اَلشَّهْرِ اَلْأَوَّلِ وَ يَقْضِيَ عَنِ اَلثَّانِي«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said: I (narrator) asked the one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, about ‘a man who became sick and did not fast until another month of Ramadan overtook him.’ So the Imams (a.s) said: “If he had recovered, then was negligent before the other fast overtook him, he fasts the one that has overtaken him, gives charity for each day with a mudd of food to a needy person, and upon him is its making up. But if he had continued to be sick until another month of Ramadan overtook him, he fasts the one that has overtaken him and gives charity for the first, for each day a mudd to a needy person, and there is no making up upon him.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مَرِضَ فَلَمْ يَصُمْ حَتَّى أَدْرَكَهُ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانٍ آخَرُ فَقَالاَ» إِنْ كَانَ قَدْ بَرَأَ ثُمَّ تَوَانَى قَبْلَ أَنْ يُدْرِكَهُ اَلصَّوْمُ اَلْآخَرُ صَامَ اَلَّذِي أَدْرَكَهُ وَ تَصَدَّقَ عَنْ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ بِمُدٍّ مِنْ طَعَامٍ عَلَى مِسْكِينٍ وَ عَلَيْهِ قَضَاؤُهُ فَإِنْ كَانَ لَمْ يَزَلْ مَرِيضاً حَتَّى أَدْرَكَهُ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانٍ آخَرُ صَامَ اَلَّذِي أَدْرَكَهُ وَ تَصَدَّقَ عَنِ اَلْأَوَّلِ لِكُلِّ يَوْمٍ مُدّاً عَلَى مِسْكِينٍ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ قَضَاءٌ«.

items.e: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who becomes sick, then the month of Ramadan overtakes him, and it passes from him while he is sick, until another month of Ramadan overtakes him.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He gives charity for the first, and fasts the second. But if he had recovered in between them and did not fast until another month of Ramadan overtook him, he fasts both of them together and gives charity for the first.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَمْرَضُ فَيُدْرِكُهُ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ وَ يَخْرُجُ عَنْهُ وَ هُوَ مَرِيضٌ حَتَّى يُدْرِكَهُ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانٍ آخَرُ قَالَ» يَتَصَدَّقُ عَنِ اَلْأَوَّلِ وَ يَصُومُ اَلثَّانِيَ فَإِنْ كَانَ صَحَّ فِيمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَ لَمْ يَصُمْ حَتَّى أَدْرَكَهُ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانٍ آخَرُ صَامَهُمَا جَمِيعاً وَ تَصَدَّقَ عَنِ اَلْأَوَّلِ«.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, and al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man upon whom there was a portion from the month of Ramadan, then a coming month of Ramadan overtook him.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he had recovered in between that, then did not make it up until a coming (month of) Ramadan overtook him, then upon him is that he fast and that he feed a needy person for each day. And if he was sick in between that until a coming month of Ramadan overtook him, then nothing is upon him except fasting if he recovers. But if the illness continued upon him, then upon him is that he feed a needy person for each day.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ وَ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ أَبِي اَلصَّبَّاحِ اَلْكِنَانِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ طَائِفَةٌ ثُمَّ أَدْرَكَهُ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانٍ قَابِلٌ فَقَالَ» إِنْ كَانَ صَحَّ فِيمَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَقْضِهِ حَتَّى أَدْرَكَهُ رَمَضَانٌ قَابِلٌ فَإِنَّ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَصُومَ وَ أَنْ يُطْعِمَ عَنْ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ مِسْكِيناً وَ إِنْ كَانَ مَرِيضاً فِيمَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى أَدْرَكَهُ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانٍ قَابِلٌ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ اَلصِّيَامُ إِنْ صَحَّ فَإِنْ تَتَابَعَ اَلْمَرَضُ عَلَيْهِ فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُطْعِمَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ مِسْكِيناً«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam (a.s) said: “If a man is sick from (month of) Ramadan to (month of) Ramadan, then recovers, then upon him for each day that he broke the fast is only a redemption: food, and it is a mudd for each needy person.” Imam (a.s) said: “And likewise also in the expiation of an oath and the expiation of zihar, a ‘mudd’, a ‘mudd’ (for each). And if he recovers between the two (months of) Ramadans, then upon him is only that he make up the fast. But if he is negligent regarding it while he has recovered, then upon him are charity and fasting together, for each day a mudd, when he finishes that (month of) Ramadan.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِذَا مَرِضَ اَلرَّجُلُ مِنْ رَمَضَانٍ إِلَى رَمَضَانٍ ثُمَّ صَحَّ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ لِكُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَفْطَرَ فِدْيَةٌ طَعَامٌ وَهُوَ مُدٌّ لِكُلِّ مِسْكِينٍ« قَالَ» فَكَذَلِكَ أَيْضاً فِي كَفَّارَةِ اَلْيَمِينِ وَ كَفَّارَةِ اَلظِّهَارِ مُدّاً مُدّاً وَ إِنْ صَحَّ فِيمَا بَيْنَ اَلرَّمَضَانَيْنِ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ اَلصِّيَامَ فَإِنْ تَهَاوَنَ بِهِ وَ قَدْ صَحَّ فَعَلَيْهِ اَلصَّدَقَةُ وَ اَلصِّيَامُ جَمِيعاً لِكُلِّ يَوْمٍ مُدٌّ إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ اَلرَّمَضَانِ«.

items.e: And that which al-Husayn ibn Said narrated, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaa, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man whom (month of) Ramadan overtook while upon him was a (month of) Ramadan before that which he had not fasted.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He gives charity in place of each day of the (month of) Ramadan that was upon him with a mudd of food, and let him fast this one that has overtaken him. Then when he breaks the fast, let him fast the (month of) Ramadan that was upon him. For I was sick, and three (month of) Ramadans passed over me in which I did not recover, then a (month of) Ramadan overtook me, so I gave charity in place of each day of what had passed with a mudd of food. Then Allah (swt) granted me recovery, and I fasted them.”
items.o: وَ اَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَدْرَكَهُ رَمَضَانٌ وَ عَلَيْهِ رَمَضَانٌ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ لَمْ يَصُمْهُ قَالَ» يَتَصَدَّقُ بَدَلَ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ مِنَ اَلرَّمَضَانِ اَلَّذِي كَانَ عَلَيْهِ بِمُدٍّ مِنْ طَعَامٍ وَلْيَصُمْ هَذَا اَلَّذِي أَدْرَكَ فَإِذَا أَفْطَرَ فَلْيَصُمْ رَمَضَانَ اَلَّذِي كَانَ عَلَيْهِ فَإِنِّي كُنْتُ مَرِيضاً فَمَرَّ عَلَيَّ ثَلاَثُ رَمَضَانَاتٍ لَمْ أَصِحَّ فِيهِنَّ ثُمَّ أَدْرَكْتُ رَمَضَاناً فَتَصَدَّقْتُ بَدَلَ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ مِمَّا مَضَى بِمُدٍّ مِنْ طَعَامٍ ثُمَّ عَافَانِيَ اَللَّهُ وَصُمْتُهُنَّ«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadala, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam (a.s) said: “Whoever breaks the fast for something of (month of) Ramadan due to an excuse, then another (month of) Ramadan overtakes him while he is sick, let him give charity with a mudd for each day. As for me, I fasted and gave charity.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» مَنْ أَفْطَرَ شَيْئاً مِنْ رَمَضَانَ فِي عُذْرٍ ثُمَّ أَدْرَكَ رَمَضَاناً آخَرَ وَ هُوَ مَرِيضٌ فَلْيَتَصَدَّقْ بِمُدٍّ لِكُلِّ يَوْمٍ فَأَمَّا أَنَا فَإِنِّي صُمْتُ وَتَصَدَّقْتُ«.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abbad ibn Sulayman, from Sa’ad ibn Sa’ad, from a man, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who is sick in the month of Ramadan, then recovers after that, but delays the making up for a year, or less than that, or more. What is upon him in that?’ Imam (a.s) said: “I like for him to hasten the fasting, but if he has delayed it, then there is nothing upon him.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَكُونُ مَرِيضاً فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ يَصِحُّ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَيُؤَخِّرُ اَلْقَضَاءَ سَنَةً أَوْ أَقَلَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مَا عَلَيْهِ فِي ذَلِكَ قَالَ» أُحِبُّ لَهُ تَعْجِيلَ اَلصِّيَامِ فَإِنْ كَانَ أَخَّرَهُ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ«.

items.e: And al-Husayn ibn Said narrated, from al-Qasim, from Ali, from Abu Basir, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a woman who began the morning fasting in (month of) Ramadan, then when the day had risen high, she menstruated.’ Imam (a.s) said: “She breaks the fast.” He (narrator) asked: “And I asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a woman who saw purity at the beginning of the day.’” Imam (a.s) said: “She prays, completes her day, and makes it up.”
items.o: وَ رَوَى اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اِمْرَأَةٍ أَصْبَحَتْ صَائِمَةً فِي رَمَضَانَ فَلَمَّا اِرْتَفَعَ اَلنَّهَارُ حَاضَتْ قَالَ» تُفْطِرُ« قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اِمْرَأَةٍ رَأَتِ اَلطُّهْرَ أَوَّلَ اَلنَّهَارِ قَالَ» تُصَلِّي وَ تُتِمُّ يَوْمَهَا وَ تَقْضِي«.
items.h: Chapter on Ruling of the Sick Person Who Breaks the Fast Then Becomes Well during Part of the Day, the Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure, and the Traveller Who Arrives/Traveller Returns

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaa, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a traveller who entered upon his family before the sun’s decline while he had eaten.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is not proper for him to eat anything on that day of his, nor to have intercourse in the month of Ramadan, if he has a wife.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ مُسَافِرٍ دَخَلَ أَهْلَهُ قَبْلَ زَوَالِ اَلشَّمْسِ وَ قَدْ أَكَلَ قَالَ» لاَ يَنْبَغِي لَهُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ يَوْمَهُ ذَلِكَ شَيْئاً وَ لاَ يُوَاقِعَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ إِنْ كَانَ لَهُ أَهْلٌ«.

items.e: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, who said: He said regarding ‘the traveller who enters upon his family in the month of Ramadan, and he had eaten before his entry.’ He said: “He refrains from eating for the rest of his day, and upon him is making it up (the fast).” And He said: “Regarding the traveller who enters upon his family while he is in a state of major ritual impurity (janabah) before the sun’s decline, and he had not eaten, then upon him is that he complete his fast, and there is no making up upon him,” meaning if his major ritual impurity (janabah) was from a wet dream (ihtilam).
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ قَالَ قَالَ: فِي اَلْمُسَافِرِ اَلَّذِي يَدْخُلُ أَهْلَهُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ قَدْ أَكَلَ قَبْلَ دُخُولِهِ قَالَ» يَكُفُّ عَنِ اَلْأَكْلِ بَقِيَّةَ يَوْمِهِ وَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْقَضَاءُ« وَ قَالَ» فِي اَلْمُسَافِرِ يَدْخُلُ أَهْلَهُ وَ هُوَ جُنُبٌ قَبْلَ اَلزَّوَالِ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ أَكَلَ فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُتِمَّ صَوْمَهُ وَ لاَ قَضَاءَ عَلَيْهِ« يَعْنِي إِذَا كَانَتْ جَنَابَتُهُ مِنِ اِحْتِلاَمٍ.

items.e: As for what was narrated by Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Hariz ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who arrives from a journey after the afternoon prayer in the month of Ramadan, and he comes upon his wife when she has become pure from menstruation, may he have intercourse with her?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in it.”
items.o: فاما ما رواه سعد بن عبد الله عن محمد بن عيسى بن عبيد عن عثمان بن عيسى عن حريز بن عبد الله عن محمد بن مسلم قال: سألت ابا عبد الله عليه السلام عن الرجل يقدم من سفر بعد العصر في شهر رمضان فيصيب امرأته حين طهرت من الحيض أيواقعها؟ قال: لا بأس به.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadala ibn Ayyub, from al-Husayn ibn Uthman, from Samaa, from Abu Basir, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who arrives from a journey in the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he arrives before the sun’s decline, then upon him is the fasting of that day, and he counts it.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَقْدَمُ مِنْ سَفَرٍ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَقَالَ» إِنْ قَدِمَ قَبْلَ زَوَالِ اَلشَّمْسِ فَعَلَيْهِ صِيَامُ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمِ وَ يَعْتَدُّ بِهِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who arrived from a journey in the month of Ramadan and had not tasted anything before the sun’s decline.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He fasts.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ لَمْ يَطْعَمْ شَيْئاً قَبْلَ اَلزَّوَالِ قَالَ» يَصُومُ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Rifaa ibn Musa, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who comes in the month of Ramadan from a journey until he sees that he will enter upon his family in the forenoon or when the day has risen high.’ Imam (a.s) said: “When dawn rises while he is outside and has not entered, then he has the choice: if he wishes, he fasts, and if he wishes, he breaks the fast.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ مُوسَى قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُقْبِلُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ حَتَّى يَرَى أَنَّهُ سَيَدْخُلُ أَهْلَهُ ضَحْوَةً أَوِ اِرْتِفَاعَ اَلنَّهَارِ قَالَ »إِذَا طَلَعَ اَلْفَجْرُ وَ هُوَ خَارِجٌ لَمْ يَدْخُلْ فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ إِنْ شَاءَ صَامَ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ أَفْطَرَ«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who arrived from a journey in the month of Ramadan and entered upon his family when morning began or when the day had risen high.’ Imam (a.s) said: “When dawn rises while he is outside and has not entered upon his family, then he has the choice: if he wishes, he fasts, and if he wishes, he breaks the fast.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَيَدْخُلُ أَهْلَهُ حِينَ يُصْبِحُ أَوِ اِرْتِفَاعَ اَلنَّهَارِ فَقَالَ» إِذَا طَلَعَ اَلْفَجْرُ وَ هُوَ خَارِجٌ لَمْ يَدْخُلْ أَهْلَهُ فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ إِنْ شَاءَ صَامَ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ أَفْطَرَ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Udhayna, who said: I (narrator) wrote to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, asking Imam (a.s): “What is the limit of the illness whose possessor breaks the fast, and the illness whose possessor leaves prayer while standing?” Imam (a.s) said: “Rather, man is a witness over himself,” And Imam (a.s) said: “That is up to him; he is more knowledgeable of himself.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَ اهِيمَ عَنْ أَ بِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِ لَى أَ بِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَسْأَلُهُ مَا حَدُّ اَلْمَرَ ضِ اَلَّذِي يُفْطِرُ صَاحِبُهُ وَ اَلْمَرَضِ اَلَّذِي يَدَ عُ صَاحِبُهُ اَلصَّلاَةَ مِنْ قِيَا مٍ فَقَالَ » »بَلِ اَلْإِنْسٰانُ عَلىٰ نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةٌ« « وَ قَالَ »ذَاكَ إِلَيْهِ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِنَفْسِهِ«.
items.h: Chapter on Extent of Illness in Which Breaking the Fast Becomes Obligatory

items.e: And from him, from Ali, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from a man, from Samaa, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s): “What is the limit of the illness in which breaking the fast becomes obligatory upon its possessor, just as it becomes obligatory upon him during travel, when whoever is sick or on a journey?” Imam (a.s) said: “He is entrusted with it, and it is delegated to him. So if he finds weakness, let him break the fast, and if he finds strength, let him fast it, whatever the illness may be.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ مَا حَدُّ اَلْمَرَضِ اَلَّذِي يَجِبُ عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ فِيهِ اَلْإِفْطَارُ كَمَا يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ مَنْ كَانَ مَرِيضاً أَوْ عَلَى سَفَرٍ قَالَ» هُوَ مُؤْتَمَنٌ عَلَيْهِ مُفَوَّضٌ إِلَيْهِ فَإِنْ وَجَدَ ضَعْفاً فَلْيُفْطِرْ وَ إِنْ وَجَدَ قُوَّةً فَلْيَصُمْهُ كَانَ اَلْمَرَضُ مَا كَانَ«.

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya and others, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Said, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqa, from Ammar al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah (a.s): (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who finds pain in his head from a severe headache, Is it permissible for him to break the fast?’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he is afflicted with a severe headache, and if he is afflicted with a severe fever, and if his eye becomes inflamed with severe inflammation, then breaking the fast has become lawful for him.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى وَ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ ع: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَجِدُ فِي رَأْسِهِ وَجَعاً مِنْ صُدَاعٍ شَدِيدٍ هَلْ يَجُوزُ لَهُ اَلْإِفْطَارُ قَالَ» إِذَا صُدِّعَ صُدَاعاً شَدِيداً وَإِذَا حُمَّ حُمَّى شَدِيدَةً وَإِذَا رَمِدَتْ عَيْنُهُ رَمَداً شَدِيداً فَقَدْ حَلَّ لَهُ اَلْإِفْطَارُ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Sulayman ibn Hafs al-Marwazi, who said: The Jurist (al-Faqih) Imam al-Hadi (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “The sick person only prays sitting when he reaches the condition in which he is unable to walk the amount of his prayer until he finishes while standing.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ حَفْصٍ اَلْمَرْوَزِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ اَلْفَقِيهُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: »اَلْمَرِيضُ إِنَّمَا يُصَلِّي قَاعِداً إِذَا صَارَ بِالْحَالِ اَلَّتِي لاَ يَقْدِرُ فِيهَا أَنْ يَمْشِيَ مِقْدَارَ صَلاَتِهِ إِلَى أَنْ يَفْرُغَ قَائِماً«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Hilal, from Uqbah ibn Khalid, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: (Imam (a.s) was asked) concerning ‘a man who fasted (month of) Ramadan while he was ill.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He completes his fast, and he does not repeat it; it suffices him.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ صَامَ رَمَضَانَ وَ هُوَ مَرِيضٌ قَالَ» يُتِمُّ صَوْمَهُ وَ لاَ يُعِيدُ يُجْزِيهِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the fasting person pouring oil into his ear.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in it.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلصَّائِمِ يَصُبُّ فِي أُذُنِهِ اَلدُّهْنَ قَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ«.
items.h: Chapter on Ruling of Treatment for the Fasting Person, Kohl, Cupping, the Tooth-Stick (Siwak), Entering the Bathhouse, and Other than That

items.e: And from him, from Abu Ali al-Ashari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the fasting person whose ear pains him, and he pours medicine into it.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in it.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَلِيٍّ اَلْأَشْعَرِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْجَبَّارِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّائِمِ يَشْتَكِي أُذُنَهُ يَصُبُّ فِيهَا اَلدَّوَاءَ قَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ«.

items.e: And from him, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sulaym al-Farra, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the fasting person applying kohl to his eyes.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in it; it is neither food nor drink.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ سُلَيْمٍ اَلْفَرَّاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّائِمِ يَكْتَحِلُ قَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ لَيْسَ بِطَعَامٍ وَ لاَ شَرَابٍ«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Safwan, from al-Husayn ibn Abi Ghundar, from Ibn Abi Yafur, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘kohl for the fasting person.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in it; it is not food that is eaten.”
